﻿using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class BulkAddBooks : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;";

        // Коллекции для комбобоксов
        private ObservableCollection<AuthorItem> _authors;
        private ObservableCollection<ViewBookItem> _viewBooks;
        private ObservableCollection<PublisherItem> _publishers;
        private ObservableCollection<GenreItem> _genres;
        private ObservableCollection<ReceiptItem> _receipts;

        public class AuthorItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayAuthors { get; set; }
        }

        public class ViewBookItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayViewBook { get; set; }
        }

        public class PublisherItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayPH { get; set; }
        }

        public class GenreItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayGen { get; set; }
        }

        // НОВЫЙ КЛАСС: для акта поступления
        public class ReceiptItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string ReceiptNumber { get; set; }
            public DateTime ReceiptDate { get; set; }
            public string DisplayReceipt => $"{ReceiptNumber} от {ReceiptDate:dd.MM.yyyy}";
        }

        public BulkAddBooks()
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            // Загружаем данные
            LoadAuthors();
            LoadViewBooks();
            LoadPublishers();
            LoadGenres();
            LoadReceipts(); // НОВЫЙ МЕТОД: загрузка актов поступления

            // Подписываемся на события
            QuantityBox.TextChanged += QuantityBox_TextChanged;

            // Обновляем предпросмотр после загрузки страницы
            this.Loaded += (s, e) =>
            {
                UpdateInventoryPreview();
            };
        }

        private void LoadAuthors()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Autor, SurnameAuthor, NameAuthor, PatronymicAuthor FROM Authors ORDER BY SurnameAuthor";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        _authors = new ObservableCollection<AuthorItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["ID_Autor"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Autor"]);
                            string surname = reader["SurnameAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            string name = reader["NameAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            string patronymic = reader["PatronymicAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "";

                            _authors.Add(new AuthorItem
                            {
                                ID = id,
                                DisplayAuthors = $"{surname} {name} {patronymic}".Trim()
                            });
                        }

                        AuthorCombo.ItemsSource = _authors;
                        AuthorCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayAuthors";
                        AuthorCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки авторов: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadViewBooks()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_View_Book, View_Book FROM ViewBook ORDER BY View_Book";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        _viewBooks = new ObservableCollection<ViewBookItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["ID_View_Book"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_View_Book"]);
                            string view = reader["View_Book"]?.ToString() ?? "";

                            _viewBooks.Add(new ViewBookItem
                            {
                                ID = id,
                                DisplayViewBook = view
                            });
                        }

                        ViewBookCombo.ItemsSource = _viewBooks;
                        ViewBookCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayViewBook";
                        ViewBookCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки видов книг: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadPublishers()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT IDPublishingHouse, TitlePublishingHouse FROM PublishingHouse ORDER BY TitlePublishingHouse";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        _publishers = new ObservableCollection<PublisherItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["IDPublishingHouse"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDPublishingHouse"]);
                            string title = reader["TitlePublishingHouse"]?.ToString() ?? "";

                            _publishers.Add(new PublisherItem
                            {
                                ID = id,
                                DisplayPH = title
                            });
                        }

                        PublisherCombo.ItemsSource = _publishers;
                        PublisherCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayPH";
                        PublisherCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки издательств: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadGenres()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Gener, TitleGener FROM GenersBook ORDER BY TitleGener";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        _genres = new ObservableCollection<GenreItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["ID_Gener"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Gener"]);
                            string title = reader["TitleGener"]?.ToString() ?? "";

                            _genres.Add(new GenreItem
                            {
                                ID = id,
                                DisplayGen = title
                            });
                        }

                        GenreCombo.ItemsSource = _genres;
                        GenreCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayGen";
                        GenreCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки жанров: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        // НОВЫЙ МЕТОД: загрузка актов поступления
        private void LoadReceipts()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT IDReceipt, ReceiptNumber, ReceiptDate FROM ReceiptBooks ORDER BY ReceiptNumber DESC";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        _receipts = new ObservableCollection<ReceiptItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["IDReceipt"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDReceipt"]);
                            string receiptNumber = reader["ReceiptNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            DateTime receiptDate = reader["ReceiptDate"] != DBNull.Value
                                ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReceiptDate"])
                                : DateTime.Now;

                            _receipts.Add(new ReceiptItem
                            {
                                ID = id,
                                ReceiptNumber = receiptNumber,
                                ReceiptDate = receiptDate
                            });
                        }

                        ReceiptCombo.ItemsSource = _receipts;
                        ReceiptCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayReceipt";
                        ReceiptCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";

                        // Выбираем первый акт по умолчанию (если есть)
                        if (_receipts.Count > 0)
                        {
                            ReceiptCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки актов поступления: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateInventoryPreview()
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем, что элементы управления инициализированы
                if (QuantityBox == null || InventoryPreviewText == null)
                    return;

                int quantity = 1;

                // Безопасно парсим количество
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(QuantityBox.Text))
                {
                    int.TryParse(QuantityBox.Text, out quantity);
                }

                if (quantity < 1) quantity = 1;

                int nextNumber = GetNextInventoryNumber();
                var previewNumbers = new System.Text.StringBuilder();

                for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(quantity, 5); i++)
                {
                    if (i > 0) previewNumbers.Append(", ");
                    previewNumbers.Append($"{nextNumber + i:D6}");
                }

                if (quantity > 5)
                {
                    previewNumbers.Append($" ... и ещё {quantity - 5}");
                }

                InventoryPreviewText.Text = previewNumbers.ToString();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка в UpdateInventoryPreview: {ex.Message}");
                if (InventoryPreviewText != null)
                    InventoryPreviewText.Text = "Ошибка генерации номеров";
            }
        }

        private int GetNextInventoryNumber()
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(InventaryNumber AS INT)), 0)
                FROM Books 
                WHERE ISNUMERIC(InventaryNumber) = 1";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    int maxNum = (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                    return maxNum + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        private bool ValidateForm()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TitleBox.Text))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите название книги.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                TitleBox.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (AuthorCombo.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите автора.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                AuthorCombo.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (ViewBookCombo.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите вид книги.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                ViewBookCombo.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (!int.TryParse(YearBox.Text, out int year) || year < 1000 || year > DateTime.Now.Year)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Введите корректный год (1000-{DateTime.Now.Year}).", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                YearBox.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (!int.TryParse(QuantityBox.Text, out int quantity) || quantity < 1 || quantity > 100)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите корректное количество экземпляров (1-100).", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                QuantityBox.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            // НОВАЯ ПРОВЕРКА: акт поступления (необязательно, но рекомендуется)
            if (ReceiptCombo.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                var result =  CustomMessageBox.Show("Акт поступления не выбран. Продолжить без привязки к акту?",
                    "Предупреждение", CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);
                if (result == CustomMessageBoxResult.No)
                {
                    ReceiptCombo.Focus();
                    return false;
                }
            }

            return true;
        }

        private void SaveButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!ValidateForm()) return;

            try
            {
                int quantity = int.Parse(QuantityBox.Text);

                string title = TitleBox.Text.Trim();
                int authorId = (int)AuthorCombo.SelectedValue;
                int viewBookId = (int)ViewBookCombo.SelectedValue;
                int? publisherId = PublisherCombo.SelectedValue as int?;
                int? genreId = GenreCombo.SelectedValue as int?;
                int year = int.Parse(YearBox.Text);

                // НОВОЕ: получаем ID акта поступления
                int? receiptId = ReceiptCombo.SelectedValue as int?;

                decimal price = 0;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(PriceBox.Text))
                {
                    decimal.TryParse(PriceBox.Text.Replace(',', '.'), out price);
                }

                int nextNumber = GetNextInventoryNumber();
                int successCount = 0;
                int statusId = GetDefaultStatusId();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            for (int i = 0; i < quantity; i++)
                            {
                                string invNumber = $"{nextNumber + i:D6}";

                                // ОБНОВЛЕННЫЙ ЗАПРОС: добавлен IDReceip
                                string query = @"
                                    INSERT INTO Books (
                                        InventaryNumber, TitleBook, Author, PublishingHouse, YearPublishing,
                                        Gener, StatusBook, ID_View_Book, Price, TotalCopies, AvailableCopies, IDReceip
                                    ) VALUES (
                                        @Inv, @Title, @Author, @Pub, @Year,
                                        @Genre, @Status, @View, @Price, 1, 1, @ReceiptId
                                    )";

                                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction))
                                {
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", invNumber);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", title);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Author", authorId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Pub", publisherId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Year", year);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Genre", genreId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Status", statusId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@View", viewBookId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Price", price);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReceiptId", receiptId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);

                                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                                    successCount++;
                                }
                            }

                            transaction.Commit();

                             CustomMessageBox.Show($"Успешно добавлено {successCount} экземпляров книг!\n" +
                                           $"Инвентарные номера: {nextNumber:D6} - {nextNumber + quantity - 1:D6}",
                                "Успех", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                            ClearForm();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException ex)
            {
                if (ex.Number == 2627) // Нарушение уникальности
                {
                     CustomMessageBox.Show("Произошла ошибка при генерации инвентарных номеров. Возможно, в базе есть нечисловые инвентарные номера.",
                        "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
                else
                {
                     CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка базы данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при сохранении: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private int GetDefaultStatusId()
        {
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                string query = "SELECT TOP 1 ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%в наличии%'";
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                {
                    var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                    return result != null ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : 1;
                }
            }
        }

                if (!char.IsDigit(c) && c != ',')
                {
                    e.Handled = true;
                    return;
                }
            }

        private ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport> LoadBookIssuanceReport(DateTime start, DateTime end)
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport>();

            string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    i.IssuanceDate,
                    b.TitleBook,
                    b.InventaryNumber,
                    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')) AS ReaderName,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Студент' THEN ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '')
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Сотрудник' THEN ISNULL(p.Post_Name, '')
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS GroupOrPost,
                    i.PlannedReturnDate,
                    i.ReturnDate,
                    i.Status,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() 
                        THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, i.PlannedReturnDate, GETDATE())
                        WHEN i.ReturnDate > i.PlannedReturnDate
                        THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, i.PlannedReturnDate, i.ReturnDate)
                        ELSE 0
                    END AS DaysOverdue
                FROM BookIssuance i
                INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
                INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
                INNER JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                WHERE CAST(i.IssuanceDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
                ORDER BY i.IssuanceDate DESC";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StartDate", start.Date);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndDate", end.Date);

                        using (SqlDataReader reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                var report = new BookIssuanceReport
                                {
                                    IssuanceDate = reader.GetDateTime(0),
                                    BookTitle = reader.GetString(1),
                                    InventoryNumber = reader.GetString(2),
                                    ReaderName = reader.GetString(3),
                                    GroupOrPost = reader.GetString(4),
                                    PlannedReturnDate = reader.GetDateTime(5),
                                    ReturnDate = reader.IsDBNull(6) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(6),
                                    Status = reader.GetString(7),
                                    DaysOverdue = reader.GetInt32(8)
                                };
                                data.Add(report);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private ObservableCollection<ReaderActivityReport> LoadReaderActivityReport()
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<ReaderActivityReport>();

            string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    r.ReaderID,
                    r.CardNumber,
                    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')) AS FullName,
                    rt.TypeName,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Студент' THEN ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '')
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Сотрудник' THEN ISNULL(p.Post_Name, '')
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS GroupOrPost,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN i.Status = 'Возвращена' THEN 1 END) AS BooksReturned,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN i.Status = 'Выдана' THEN 1 END) AS CurrentlyIssued,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OverdueBooks,
                    MAX(i.IssuanceDate) AS LastIssuanceDate
                FROM ReaderForm r
                INNER JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance i ON r.ReaderID = i.ReaderId
                GROUP BY r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName, 
                         rt.TypeName, g.GroupCode, p.Post_Name
                ORDER BY CurrentlyIssued DESC, BooksReturned DESC";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (SqlDataReader reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int booksReturned = reader.GetInt32(5);
                            int currentlyIssued = reader.GetInt32(6);

                            var report = new ReaderActivityReport
                            {
                                ReaderID = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                CardNumber = reader.GetString(1),
                                FullName = reader.GetString(2),
                                TypeName = reader.GetString(3),
                                GroupOrPost = reader.GetString(4),
                                BooksReturned = booksReturned,
                                CurrentlyIssued = currentlyIssued,
                                OverdueBooks = reader.GetInt32(7),
                                LastIssuanceDate = reader.IsDBNull(8) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(8),
                                BooksIssued = booksReturned + currentlyIssued
                            };
                            data.Add(report);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private ObservableCollection<BookFundGroupedReport> LoadBookFundReportGrouped()
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<BookFundGroupedReport>();

            string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    b.TitleBook,
                    MAX(CONCAT(a.SurnameAuthor, ' ', a.NameAuthor, ' ', ISNULL(a.PatronymicAuthor, ''))) AS AuthorName,
                    MAX(ISNULL(ph.TitlePublishingHouse, '')) AS Publisher,
                    MAX(b.YearPublishing) AS Year,
                    MAX(ISNULL(g.TitleGener, '')) AS Genre,
                    SUM(b.TotalCopies) AS TotalCopies,
                    SUM(b.AvailableCopies) AS AvailableCopies,
                    SUM(b.CopiesInUse) AS CopiesInUse
                FROM Books b
                INNER JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse ph ON b.PublishingHouse = ph.IDPublishingHouse
                LEFT JOIN GenersBook g ON b.Gener = g.ID_Gener
                GROUP BY b.TitleBook
                ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (SqlDataReader reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            var report = new BookFundGroupedReport
                            {
                                Title = reader.GetString(0),
                                AuthorName = reader.GetString(1),
                                Publisher = reader.GetString(2),
                                Year = reader.GetInt32(3),
                                Genre = reader.GetString(4),
                                TotalCopies = reader.GetInt32(5),
                                AvailableCopies = reader.GetInt32(6),
                                CopiesInUse = reader.GetInt32(7)
                            };
                            data.Add(report);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        // ==================== ОТЧЁТ 4: ИНФОРМАЦИОННОЕ ОБСЛУЖИВАНИЕ ====================
        private void ViewReportButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!ValidateDates()) return;

            var data = LoadInfoServiceReport(StartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value, EndDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);
            if (data.Count == 0)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет данных за выбранный период.", "Информация",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                return;
            }

            var dataWithTotal = AddTotalRow(data);
            ShowInfoServiceReportWindow(dataWithTotal, StartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value, EndDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);
        }

        private void ExportExcelButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!ValidateDates()) return;

            var data = LoadInfoServiceReport(StartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value, EndDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);
            if (data.Count == 0)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет данных за выбранный период.", "Информация",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                return;
            }

            ExportInfoServiceToExcel(data, StartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value, EndDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);
        }

        private ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReport> LoadInfoServiceReport(DateTime start, DateTime end)
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReport>();
            string query = @"
                SELECT id_record, date_record, delivery_book, delivery_certificate, events_count 
                FROM InformationServiseTb 
                WHERE date_record BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate 
                ORDER BY date_record, id_record";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection connection = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (SqlCommand command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StartDate", start.Date);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndDate", end.Date);

                        using (SqlDataReader reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                var report = new InfoServiceReport
                                {
                                    IdRecord = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                    DateRecord = reader.GetDateTime(1),
                                    DeliveryBook = reader.GetInt32(2),
                                    DeliveryCertificate = reader.GetInt32(3),
                                    EventsCount = reader.GetInt32(4)
                                };
                                data.Add(report);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }

            return data;
        }

        private ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReportWithTotal> AddTotalRow(ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReport> data)
        {
            var result = new ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReportWithTotal>();

            foreach (var item in data)
            {
                result.Add(new InfoServiceReportWithTotal
                {
                    DateRecord = item.DateRecord,
                    DeliveryBook = item.DeliveryBook,
                    DeliveryCertificate = item.DeliveryCertificate,
                    EventsCount = item.EventsCount,
                    IsTotal = false
                });
            }

            int totalBooks = data.Sum(x => x.DeliveryBook);
            int totalCertificates = data.Sum(x => x.DeliveryCertificate);
            int totalEvents = data.Sum(x => x.EventsCount);

            result.Add(new InfoServiceReportWithTotal
            {
                DateRecord = DateTime.MinValue,
                DeliveryBook = totalBooks,
                DeliveryCertificate = totalCertificates,
                EventsCount = totalEvents,
                IsTotal = true
            });

            return result;
        }

        // ==================== ВСПОМОГАТЕЛЬНЫЕ МЕТОДЫ ====================
        private bool ValidateDates()
        {
            if (StartDatePicker.SelectedDate == null || EndDatePicker.SelectedDate == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Пожалуйста, выберите обе даты (с и по).", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            DateTime start = StartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value.Date;
            DateTime end = EndDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value.Date;

            if (start > end)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Дата 'с' не может быть позже даты 'по'.", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        {
            var enumerableData = data as System.Collections.IEnumerable;
            if (enumerableData == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Ошибка: данные не являются коллекцией.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                return;
            }

            var reportWindow = new Window
            {
                Title = title,
                Width = 1300,
                Height = 800,
                WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen
            };

            var mainPanel = new StackPanel();

            var headerPanel = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(10, 10, 10, 5) };
            headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = title,
                FontSize = 18,
                FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 5)
            });

            if (startDate.HasValue && endDate.HasValue)
            {
                headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
                {
                    Text = $"Период: с {startDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy} по {endDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}",
                    FontSize = 12,
                    Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray
                });
            }

            headerPanel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
            {
                Text = $"Дата формирования: {DateTime.Now:dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss}",
                FontSize = 11,
                Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 3, 0, 0)
            });

            mainPanel.Children.Add(headerPanel);

            var dataGrid = new DataGrid
            {
                AutoGenerateColumns = true,
                IsReadOnly = true,
                Margin = new Thickness(10),
                ItemsSource = enumerableData,
                VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto,
                HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto
            };

            dataGrid.AutoGeneratingColumn += (s, e) =>
            {
                switch (e.PropertyName)
                {
                    case "IssuanceDate": e.Column.Header = "Дата выдачи"; break;
                    case "BookTitle": e.Column.Header = "Название книги"; break;
                    case "InventoryNumber": e.Column.Header = "Инв. номер"; break;
                    case "ReaderName": e.Column.Header = "Читатель"; break;
                    case "GroupOrPost": e.Column.Header = "Группа/Должность"; break;
                    case "PlannedReturnDate": e.Column.Header = "План. возврат"; break;
                    case "ReturnDate": e.Column.Header = "Дата возврата"; break;
                    case "Status": e.Column.Header = "Статус"; break;
                    case "DaysOverdue": e.Column.Header = "Дней просрочки"; break;
                    case "CardNumber": e.Column.Header = "№ билета"; break;
                    case "FullName": e.Column.Header = "ФИО"; break;
                    case "TypeName": e.Column.Header = "Тип"; break;
                    case "BooksIssued": e.Column.Header = "Всего выдано"; break;
                    case "BooksReturned": e.Column.Header = "Возвращено"; break;
                    case "CurrentlyIssued": e.Column.Header = "На руках"; break;
                    case "OverdueBooks": e.Column.Header = "Просрочено"; break;
                    case "LastIssuanceDate": e.Column.Header = "Последняя выдача"; break;
                    case "AuthorName": e.Column.Header = "Автор"; break;
                    case "Publisher": e.Column.Header = "Издательство"; break;
                    case "Year": e.Column.Header = "Год"; break;
                    case "Genre": e.Column.Header = "Жанр"; break;
                    case "TotalCopies": e.Column.Header = "Всего"; break;
                    case "AvailableCopies": e.Column.Header = "Доступно"; break;
                    case "CopiesInUse": e.Column.Header = "В использовании"; break;
                    case "Title": e.Column.Header = "Название книги"; break;
                    case "ReaderID": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "IDBook": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "IdRecord": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "IsTotal": e.Column.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; break;
                    case "DisplayDate": e.Column.Header = "Дата"; break;
                    case "DeliveryBook": e.Column.Header = "Выдано книг"; break;
                    case "DeliveryCertificate": e.Column.Header = "Выдано справок"; break;
                    case "EventsCount": e.Column.Header = "Обслужено на мероприятиях (чел.)"; break;
                }

                e.Column.Width = new DataGridLength(1, DataGridLengthUnitType.Auto);

                if (e.PropertyName == "IssuanceDate" || e.PropertyName == "PlannedReturnDate" || e.PropertyName == "DateRecord")
                {
                    if (e.Column is DataGridTextColumn textColumn)
                    {
                        textColumn.Binding.StringFormat = "dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm";

                }
                else if (e.PropertyName == "ReturnDate" || e.PropertyName == "LastIssuanceDate")

                    if (e.Column is DataGridTextColumn textColumn)
                    {

                    }
                }
            };

            mainPanel.Children.Add(dataGrid);
            reportWindow.Content = mainPanel;
            reportWindow.ShowDialog();
        }

        // ==================== ГЕНЕРАЦИЯ PDF ====================

        private void CreateAndShowPDF<T>(ObservableCollection<T> data, string reportName, DateTime? startDate, DateTime? endDate, string[] headers, Func<T, string[]> getValues)
        {
            string tempFile = Path.GetTempFileName() + ".pdf";

            try
            {
                GeneratePDFWithHeader(data, tempFile, reportName, startDate, endDate, headers, getValues);
                System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo(tempFile) { UseShellExecute = true });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка создания PDF: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void GeneratePDFWithHeader<T>(ObservableCollection<T> data, string filePath, string title, DateTime? startDate, DateTime? endDate, string[] headers, Func<T, string[]> getValues)
        {
            using (PdfDocument document = new PdfDocument())
            {
                document.Info.Title = title;
                document.Info.Author = "Библиотечная система";
                document.Info.CreationDate = DateTime.Now;

                PdfPage page = document.AddPage();
                page.Orientation = PdfSharp.PageOrientation.Landscape;

                using (XGraphics gfx = XGraphics.FromPdfPage(page))
                {
                    XFont titleFont = new XFont("Arial", 16, XFontStyle.Bold);
                    XFont headerFont = new XFont("Arial", 10, XFontStyle.Bold);
                    XFont dataFont = new XFont("Arial", 9, XFontStyle.Regular);
                    XFont italicFont = new XFont("Arial", 9, XFontStyle.Italic);

                    double yPoint = 40;
                    double leftMargin = 30;
                    double rowHeight = 25;

                    double[] columnWidths = CalculateAutoColumnWidths(gfx, headers, data, getValues, dataFont, page.Width.Point - 60);

                    gfx.DrawString(title, titleFont, XBrushes.Black, new XRect(0, yPoint, page.Width.Point, 30), XStringFormats.TopCenter);
                    yPoint += 35;

                    if (startDate.HasValue && endDate.HasValue)
                    {
                        string periodText = $"Период: с {startDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy} по {endDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                        gfx.DrawString(periodText, italicFont, XBrushes.Gray,
                            new XRect(leftMargin, yPoint, page.Width.Point - 60, 20), XStringFormats.TopLeft);
                        yPoint += 18;
                    }

                    string dateGenerated = $"Дата формирования: {DateTime.Now:dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss}";
                    gfx.DrawString(dateGenerated, italicFont, XBrushes.Gray,
                        new XRect(leftMargin, yPoint, page.Width.Point - 60, 20), XStringFormats.TopLeft);
                    yPoint += 25;

                    double currentX = leftMargin;
                    for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                    {
                        gfx.DrawRectangle(XBrushes.LightGray, currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight);
                        gfx.DrawString(headers[i], headerFont, XBrushes.Black,
                            new XRect(currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight), XStringFormats.Center);
                        currentX += columnWidths[i];
                    }
                    yPoint += rowHeight;

                    foreach (var item in data)
                    {
                        string[] values = getValues(item);
                        currentX = leftMargin;

                        for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
                        {
                            gfx.DrawRectangle(XBrushes.White, currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight);
                            gfx.DrawString(TruncateString(values[i], (int)(columnWidths[i] / 5)), dataFont, XBrushes.Black,
                                new XRect(currentX + 3, yPoint, columnWidths[i] - 6, rowHeight), XStringFormats.TopLeft);
                            currentX += columnWidths[i];
                        }
                        yPoint += rowHeight;

                        if (yPoint > page.Height.Point - 50)
                        {
                            page = document.AddPage();
                            page.Orientation = PdfSharp.PageOrientation.Landscape;
                            using (XGraphics newGfx = XGraphics.FromPdfPage(page))
                            {
                                yPoint = 40;
                                currentX = leftMargin;
                                for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                                {
                                    newGfx.DrawRectangle(XBrushes.LightGray, currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight);
                                    newGfx.DrawString(headers[i], headerFont, XBrushes.Black,
                                        new XRect(currentX, yPoint, columnWidths[i], rowHeight), XStringFormats.Center);
                                    currentX += columnWidths[i];
                                }
                                yPoint += rowHeight;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                document.Save(filePath);
            }
        }

        private double[] CalculateAutoColumnWidths<T>(XGraphics gfx, string[] headers, ObservableCollection<T> data, Func<T, string[]> getValues, XFont font, double totalWidth)
        {
            double[] widths = new double[headers.Length];

            for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
            {
                widths[i] = gfx.MeasureString(headers[i], font).Width + 10;
            }

            foreach (var item in data)
            {
                string[] values = getValues(item);
                for (int i = 0; i < values.Length && i < headers.Length; i++)
                {
                    double textWidth = gfx.MeasureString(values[i], font).Width + 15;
                    if (textWidth > widths[i])
                    {
                        widths[i] = Math.Min(textWidth, 150);
                    }
                }
            }

            return widths;
        }

        private string TruncateString(string text, int maxLength)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Length <= maxLength)
                return text;
            return text.Substring(0, maxLength - 3) + "...";
        }

        // ==================== ЭКСПОРТ В EXCEL ====================
        private void ExportBookIssuanceToExcel(ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport> data, DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, bool openAfterExport = false)
        {
            SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new SaveFileDialog
            {
                Filter = "Excel файлы (*.xlsx)|*.xlsx",
                FileName = $"Отчёт_Выдача_литературы_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmm}.xlsx"
            };

            if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                try
                {
                    ExportToExcelGeneric(data, saveFileDialog.FileName, startDate, endDate, "Отчёт по выдаче литературы", new[]
                    {
                        "Дата выдачи", "Название книги", "Инв. номер", "Читатель",
                        "Группа/Должность", "План. возврат", "Дата возврата", "Статус", "Дней просрочки"
                    }, item => new object[]
                    {
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).IssuanceDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm"),
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).BookTitle,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).InventoryNumber,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).ReaderName,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).GroupOrPost,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).PlannedReturnDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy"),
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).ReturnDate?.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy") ?? "Не возвращена",
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).Status,
                        ((BookIssuanceReport)item).DaysOverdue
                    });

                    if (openAfterExport)
                    {
                        System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo(saveFileDialog.FileName) { UseShellExecute = true });
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        CustomMessageBox.Show($"Отчёт сохранён:\n{saveFileDialog.FileName}", "Успешно",
                            CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка экспорта: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ExportInfoServiceToExcelGeneric(ObservableCollection<InfoServiceReport> data, string filePath, DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
        {
            Excel.Application excelApp = null;
            Excel.Workbook workbook = null;
            Excel.Worksheet worksheet = null;

            try
            {
                excelApp = new Excel.Application();
                excelApp.Visible = false;

                workbook = excelApp.Workbooks.Add();
                worksheet = workbook.ActiveSheet;
                worksheet.Name = "Информационное обслуживание";

                int currentRow = 1;

                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = "Информационное обслуживание";
                var titleRange = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1];
                titleRange.Font.Bold = true;
                titleRange.Font.Size = 16;
                titleRange.Merge(worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 4]);
                currentRow += 2;

                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = $"Период: с {startDate:dd.MM.yyyy} по {endDate:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                currentRow++;

                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = $"Дата формирования: {DateTime.Now:dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss}";
                currentRow += 2;

                string[] headers = { "Дата", "Выдано книг", "Выдано справок", "Обслужено на мероприятиях (чел.)" };
                for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, i + 1] = headers[i];
                    var range = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, i + 1];
                    range.Font.Bold = true;
                    range.Interior.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LightGray.ToArgb();
                }
                currentRow++;

                int totalBooks = 0;
                int totalCertificates = 0;
                int totalEvents = 0;

                foreach (var item in data)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = item.DisplayDate;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 2] = item.DeliveryBook;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 3] = item.DeliveryCertificate;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 4] = item.EventsCount;

                    totalBooks += item.DeliveryBook;
                    totalCertificates += item.DeliveryCertificate;
                    totalEvents += item.EventsCount;

                    currentRow++;
                }

                currentRow++;
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = "ИТОГО:";
                var totalRange = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1];
                totalRange.Font.Bold = true;
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 2] = totalBooks;
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 3] = totalCertificates;
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 4] = totalEvents;

                ((Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 2]).Font.Bold = true;
                ((Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 3]).Font.Bold = true;
                ((Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 4]).Font.Bold = true;

                worksheet.Columns.AutoFit();
                workbook.SaveAs(filePath, Excel.XlFileFormat.xlOpenXMLWorkbook);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (worksheet != null) System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(worksheet);
                if (workbook != null)
                {
                    workbook.Close(false);
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(workbook);
                }
                if (excelApp != null)
                {
                    excelApp.Quit();
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(excelApp);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ExportToExcelGeneric<T>(ObservableCollection<T> data, string filePath, DateTime? startDate, DateTime? endDate, string title, string[] headers, Func<T, object[]> getValues)
        {
            Excel.Application excelApp = null;
            Excel.Workbook workbook = null;
            Excel.Worksheet worksheet = null;

            try
            {
                excelApp = new Excel.Application();
                excelApp.Visible = false;

                workbook = excelApp.Workbooks.Add();
                worksheet = workbook.ActiveSheet;
                worksheet.Name = "Отчёт";

                int currentRow = 1;

                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = title;
                var titleRange = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1];
                titleRange.Font.Bold = true;
                titleRange.Font.Size = 16;
                titleRange.Merge(worksheet.Cells[currentRow, headers.Length]);
                currentRow += 2;

                if (startDate.HasValue && endDate.HasValue)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = $"Период: с {startDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy} по {endDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                    currentRow++;
                }

                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = $"Дата формирования: {DateTime.Now:dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss}";
                currentRow += 2;

                for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, i + 1] = headers[i];
                    var range = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, i + 1];
                    range.Font.Bold = true;
                    range.Interior.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LightGray.ToArgb();
                }
                currentRow++;

                foreach (var item in data)
                {
                    var values = getValues(item);
                    for (int col = 0; col < values.Length; col++)
                    {
                        worksheet.Cells[currentRow, col + 1] = values[col];
                    }
                    currentRow++;
                }

                if (data.Count > 0)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = "Итого записей:";
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 2] = data.Count;
                    var итогRange = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1];
                    итогRange.Font.Bold = true;
                }

                worksheet.Columns.AutoFit();
                workbook.SaveAs(filePath, Excel.XlFileFormat.xlOpenXMLWorkbook);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (worksheet != null) System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(worksheet);
                if (workbook != null)
                {
                    workbook.Close(false);
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(workbook);
                }
                if (excelApp != null)
                {
                    excelApp.Quit();
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(excelApp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

﻿using System;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class AddViewBook : Page
    {
        private readonly string connectionString =
            "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;MultipleActiveResultSets=True;";

        private int? _currentViewBookId = null;
        private System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<object> _allViewBooks;

        public AddViewBook()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoadViewBooks();
        }


        private void LoadViewBooks()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = @"
                    SELECT ID_View_Book, View_Book 
                    FROM ViewBook 
                    ORDER BY View_Book";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<object>();

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new
                            {
                                ID_View_Book = reader["ID_View_Book"] is int id ? id : 0,
                                View_Book = reader["View_Book"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }

                        _allViewBooks = items;
                        ApplyFilter("");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки видов книг:\n{ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }


        private void ApplyFilter(string searchTerm)
        {
            if (_allViewBooks == null)
            {
                LvStatusBook.ItemsSource = null;
                return;
            }

            var filtered = _allViewBooks
                .Where(item =>
                {
                    var name = item.GetType().GetProperty("View_Book")?.GetValue(item)?.ToString() ?? "";
                    return string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm) ||
                           name.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
                })
                .ToList();

            LvStatusBook.ItemsSource = new System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<object>(filtered);
        }


        private void ClearFields()
        {
            View_Book_Tb.Clear();
            _currentViewBookId = null;
            SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }


        private void SaveNewRecordButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            string viewName = View_Book_Tb.Text?.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(viewName))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите название вида книги.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            const string query = "INSERT INTO ViewBook (View_Book) VALUES (@View_Book);";

            try
            {
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@View_Book", viewName);
                        int rows = command.ExecuteNonQuery();

                        if (rows > 0)
                        {
                             CustomMessageBox.Show($"Вид «{viewName}» успешно добавлен.",
                                "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            ClearFields();
                            LoadViewBooks(); // Обновляем список
                        }
                        else
                        {
                             CustomMessageBox.Show("Не удалось добавить запись.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Number == 2627 || ex.Number == 547)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Такой вид книги уже существует или нарушено ограничение целостности.",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка:\n{ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }


        private void SaveChangesButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentViewBookId.HasValue)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет выбранной записи для редактирования.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            string viewName = View_Book_Tb.Text?.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(viewName))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите название вида книги.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            const string query = @"
                UPDATE ViewBook 
                SET View_Book = @View_Book 
                WHERE ID_View_Book = @Id;";

            try
            {
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@View_Book", viewName);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", _currentViewBookId.Value);

                        int rows = command.ExecuteNonQuery();
                        if (rows > 0)
                        {
                             CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись успешно обновлена.", "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            ClearFields();
                            LoadViewBooks();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                             CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись не найдена (возможно, удалена).", "Внимание", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                            ClearFields();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка обновления:\n{ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }


        private void DeleteButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentViewBookId.HasValue)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет выбранной записи для удаления.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            var result =  CustomMessageBox.Show(
                "Удалить выбранный вид книги?",
                "Подтверждение", CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

            if (result != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            const string query = "DELETE FROM ViewBook WHERE ID_View_Book = @Id;";

            try
            {
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", _currentViewBookId.Value);
                        int rows = command.ExecuteNonQuery();

                        if (rows > 0)
                        {
                             CustomMessageBox.Show("Вид книги удалён.", "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            ClearFields();
                            LoadViewBooks();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                             CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись уже удалена.", "Внимание", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                            ClearFields();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Number == 547)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Невозможно удалить: на этот вид ссылаются другие записи (например, книги).",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка удаления:\n{ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

    
        private void LvStatusBook_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            var item = LvStatusBook.SelectedItem;
            if (item == null) return;

            try
            {
                dynamic view = item;
                _currentViewBookId = view.ID_View_Book;
                View_Book_Tb.Text = view.View_Book;

                SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных:\n{ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void SearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            string term = SearchBox.Text.Trim();
            ApplyFilter(term);
        }

        private void SearchBox_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
            {
                SearchBox.Clear();
                SearchBox.Focus();
            }
        }

        private void ClosePage_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.GoBack();
        }
    }
}
