﻿using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    // Класс для причины списания
    public class ReasonDisposalBook
    {
        public int ID_Reason { get; set; }
        public string ReasonName { get; set; }
    }

    public partial class DisposalAct : Page
    {
        private readonly string _conn = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;";
        private readonly ObservableCollection<BookItem> _items = new ObservableCollection<BookItem>();
        private int _nextRowNum = 1;
        private int? _currentWriteOffId = null;

        public DisposalAct()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            DgItems.ItemsSource = _items;
            LoadReasons();
            DpDate.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;

            // Генерируем следующий номер акта
            string nextNumber = GetNextDisposalNumber();
            TbActNumber.Text = nextNumber;
        }

        private class BookItem
        {
            public int RowNum { get; set; }
            public string InventoryNumber { get; set; }
            public string Author { get; set; }
            public string Title { get; set; }
            public string PublishingHouse { get; set; }
            public int Year { get; set; }
            public int PriceRub { get; set; }
            public int PriceKop { get; set; }
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public decimal TotalPrice => (PriceRub + PriceKop / 100m) * Quantity;
            public string PlaceYear => $"{PublishingHouse}, {Year}";
        }

        private class BookStatusCheckResult
        {
            public bool CanBeDisposed { get; set; }
            public string Message { get; set; }
            public bool IsIssued { get; set; }
            public string IssuedInfo { get; set; }
        }

        private void LoadReasons()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Reason, ReasonName FROM ReasonDisposalBook ORDER BY ReasonName";
                var reasons = new ObservableCollection<ReasonDisposalBook>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            reasons.Add(new ReasonDisposalBook
                            {
                                ID_Reason = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Reason"]),
                                ReasonName = reader["ReasonName"].ToString()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                CbReason.ItemsSource = reasons;
                CbReason.DisplayMemberPath = "ReasonName";
                CbReason.SelectedValuePath = "ID_Reason";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки причин: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void BtnFindBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            string inv = TbSearchInv.Text.Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(inv))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите инвентарный номер книги!");
                return;
            }

            // Проверка дубликатов в текущем акте
            if (_items.Any(item => item.InventoryNumber == inv))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книга {inv} уже добавлена в акт.");
                TbSearchInv.Clear();
                return;
            }

            // Проверка статуса книги
            var bookCheckResult = CheckBookStatus(inv);
            if (!bookCheckResult.CanBeDisposed)
            {
                // Если книга выдана, показываем подробную информацию
                if (bookCheckResult.Message.Contains("находится на руках"))
                {
                    string issuedInfo = GetIssuedInfo(inv);
                     CustomMessageBox.Show($"{bookCheckResult.Message}\n\n{issuedInfo}",
                        "Невозможно списать", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                }
                else
                {
                     CustomMessageBox.Show(bookCheckResult.Message);
                }
                TbSearchInv.Clear();
                return;
            }

            var book = LoadBookByInventory(inv);
            if (book != null)
            {
                LbInventory.Text = book.InventoryNumber;
                LbTitle.Text = $"{book.Author} — {book.Title}";
                LbPubYear.Text = book.PlaceYear;
                LbPrice.Text = $"{book.PriceRub}.{book.PriceKop:D2} руб.";
                PnBookDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                TbSearchInv.IsEnabled = false;
            }
        }

        private BookStatusCheckResult CheckBookStatus(string inventoryNumber)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    b.ID_Disposal,
                    s.Title_Status AS StatusName,
                    b.StatusBook,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL OR gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END AS IsIssued
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN StatusBook s ON b.StatusBook = s.ID_Status
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance bi ON b.IDBook = bi.BookId AND bi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON b.IDBook = git.BookId
                LEFT JOIN GroupBookIssuance gi ON git.GroupIssuanceId = gi.GroupIssuanceId AND gi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                WHERE b.InventaryNumber = @Inv";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", inventoryNumber);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            // Проверяем, выдана ли книга
                            bool isIssued = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IsIssued"]) == 1;

                            if (isIssued)
                            {
                                return new BookStatusCheckResult
                                {
                                    CanBeDisposed = false,
                                    Message = $"Книга {inventoryNumber} находится на руках у читателя. Сначала необходимо вернуть книгу.",
                                    IsIssued = true
                                };
                            }

                            // Проверяем ID_Disposal
                            if (reader["ID_Disposal"] != DBNull.Value)
                            {
                                return new BookStatusCheckResult
                                {
                                    CanBeDisposed = false,
                                    Message = $"Книга {inventoryNumber} уже списана."
                                };
                            }

                            string statusName = reader["StatusName"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(statusName) && statusName.ToLower().Contains("списана"))
                            {
                                return new BookStatusCheckResult
                                {
                                    CanBeDisposed = false,
                                    Message = $"Книга имеет статус '{statusName}'."
                                };
                            }

                            return new BookStatusCheckResult { CanBeDisposed = true, Message = "" };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return new BookStatusCheckResult { CanBeDisposed = false, Message = "Книга не найдена" };
        }

        private string GetIssuedInfo(string inventoryNumber)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL THEN 
                            'читателю ' + r.LastName + ' ' + r.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')
                        WHEN gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN 
                            'группе ' + g.GroupCode + ' (преп. ' + t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName + ')'
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS RecipientInfo,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL THEN bi.IssuanceDate
                        WHEN gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN gi.IssuanceDate
                        ELSE NULL
                    END AS IssueDate,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL THEN bi.PlannedReturnDate
                        WHEN gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN gi.PlannedReturnDate
                        ELSE NULL
                    END AS PlannedReturnDate
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance bi ON b.IDBook = bi.BookId AND bi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN ReaderForm r ON bi.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
                LEFT JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON b.IDBook = git.BookId
                LEFT JOIN GroupBookIssuance gi ON git.GroupIssuanceId = gi.GroupIssuanceId AND gi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
                WHERE b.InventaryNumber = @Inv";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", inventoryNumber);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            string recipientInfo = reader["RecipientInfo"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            DateTime? issueDate = reader["IssueDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssueDate"]) : (DateTime?)null;
                            DateTime? plannedReturnDate = reader["PlannedReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null;

                            string result = recipientInfo;
                            if (issueDate.HasValue)
                            {
                                result += $"\nДата выдачи: {issueDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                            }
                            if (plannedReturnDate.HasValue)
                            {
                                result += $"\nПлановая дата возврата: {plannedReturnDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                                if (plannedReturnDate.Value < DateTime.Today)
                                {
                                    result += "\nВНИМАНИЕ: Просрочена!";
                                }
                            }
                            return result;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return "";
        }

        private BookItem LoadBookByInventory(string inv)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    b.InventaryNumber AS Inv,
                    b.TitleBook AS Title,
                    ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS Author,
                    ISNULL(p.TitlePublishingHouse, '') AS Pub,
                    b.YearPublishing AS Year,
                    CAST(FLOOR(ISNULL(b.Price, 0)) AS int) AS PriceRub,
                    CAST((ISNULL(b.Price, 0) - FLOOR(ISNULL(b.Price, 0))) * 100 AS int) AS PriceKop,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReaderId IS NOT NULL OR gi.GroupIssuanceId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END AS IsIssued
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse p ON b.PublishingHouse = p.IDPublishingHouse
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance bi ON b.IDBook = bi.BookId AND bi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                LEFT JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON b.IDBook = git.BookId
                LEFT JOIN GroupBookIssuance gi ON git.GroupIssuanceId = gi.GroupIssuanceId AND gi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                WHERE b.InventaryNumber = @Inv";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", inv);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            bool isIssued = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IsIssued"]) == 1;

                            if (isIssued)
                            {
                                // Книга выдана, показываем информацию
                                string issuedInfo = GetIssuedInfo(inv);
                                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книга {inv} находится на руках!\n\n{issuedInfo}",
                                    "Невозможно списать", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                                return null;
                            }

                            return new BookItem
                            {
                                InventoryNumber = reader["Inv"].ToString(),
                                Title = reader["Title"].ToString(),
                                Author = reader["Author"].ToString(),
                                PublishingHouse = reader["Pub"].ToString(),
                                Year = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Year"]),
                                PriceRub = Convert.ToInt32(reader["PriceRub"]),
                                PriceKop = Convert.ToInt32(reader["PriceKop"])
                            };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        private void BtnAddToAct_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем, что все необходимые поля заполнены
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(LbInventory.Text) || LbInventory.Text == "не найдена")
                {
                     CustomMessageBox.Show("Сначала найдите книгу по инвентарному номеру.", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    return;
                }

                // Парсим цену
                string priceText = LbPrice.Text.Replace(" руб.", "").Trim();
                string[] priceParts = priceText.Split('.');
                int priceRub = int.Parse(priceParts[0]);
                int priceKop = priceParts.Length > 1 ? int.Parse(priceParts[1]) : 0;

                // Парсим год и издательство
                string pubYearText = LbPubYear.Text;
                string publishingHouse = "";
                int year = DateTime.Now.Year;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(pubYearText) && pubYearText.Contains(","))
                {
                    var parts = pubYearText.Split(',');
                    publishingHouse = parts[0].Trim();
                    if (parts.Length > 1 && int.TryParse(parts[1].Trim(), out int parsedYear))
                    {
                        year = parsedYear;
                    }
                }

                // Парсим название и автора
                string titleText = LbTitle.Text;
                string author = "";
                string title = titleText;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(titleText) && titleText.Contains("—"))
                {
                    var parts = titleText.Split('—');
                    author = parts[0].Trim();
                    title = parts.Length > 1 ? parts[1].Trim() : titleText;
                }

                var item = new BookItem
                {
                    RowNum = _nextRowNum++,
                    InventoryNumber = LbInventory.Text,
                    Title = title,
                    Author = author,
                    PublishingHouse = publishingHouse,
                    Year = year,
                    PriceRub = priceRub,
                    PriceKop = priceKop,
                    Quantity = 1
                };

                _items.Add(item);

                // Показываем DataGrid и обновляем UI
                DgItems.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                DgItems.ItemsSource = _items;

                // Показываем заголовок таблицы и панель итогов
                TableHeader.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                TotalPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

                // Скрываем панель с деталями книги
                PnBookDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

                // Очищаем поле поиска
                TbSearchInv.Clear();
                TbSearchInv.IsEnabled = true;

                // Обновляем счетчик книг
                BooksCountLabel.Text = $"(всего: {_items.Count} книг)";

                // Обновляем итоговую сумму
                UpdateTotal();

                // Очищаем поля найденной книги
                ClearBookDetails();

                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книга '{title}' добавлена в акт списания.", "Успешно",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при добавлении книги: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void ClearBookDetails()
        {
            LbInventory.Text = "";
            LbTitle.Text = "";
            LbPubYear.Text = "";
            LbPrice.Text = "";
        }

        private void UpdateTotal()
        {
            decimal total = 0;
            foreach (var i in _items)
            {
                total += i.TotalPrice;
            }
            TbTotal.Text = total.ToString("N2");
        }

        private void BtnGenerateAct_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_items.Count == 0)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Добавьте книги в акт.");
                return;
            }

            if (CbReason.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите причину списания.");
                return;
            }

            var selectedReason = (ReasonDisposalBook)CbReason.SelectedItem;
            string actNumber = TbActNumber.Text.Trim();
            string participants = TbParticipants.Text.Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(actNumber) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(participants))
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show("Заполните все поля.");
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            // 1. Создаем акт списания
                            int writeOffId;
                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                                INSERT INTO DisposalBooks (DisposalNumber, DisposalDate, Participants, Reason)
                                VALUES (@Number, @Date, @Participants, @Reason);
                                SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();", conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Number", actNumber);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", DpDate.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Participants", participants);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Reason", selectedReason.ID_Reason);

                                writeOffId = Convert.ToInt32(cmd.ExecuteScalar());
                                _currentWriteOffId = writeOffId;
                            }

                            // 2. Получаем ID статуса "Списана"
                            int disposedStatusId = GetDisposedStatusId(conn, transaction);

                            // 3. Добавляем книги в DisposalItems и обновляем Books
                            foreach (var item in _items)
                            {
                                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                                    INSERT INTO DisposalItems (IDDisposal, InventoryNumber, TitleBook, PriceRub, PriceKop, Quantity, TotalPrice)
                                    VALUES (@ID, @Inv, @Title, @Rub, @Kop, @Qty, @Total);
                                    
                                    UPDATE Books 
                                    SET ID_Disposal = @ID, StatusBook = @StatusId
                                    WHERE InventaryNumber = @Inv;", conn, transaction))
                                {
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ID", writeOffId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", item.InventoryNumber);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", item.Title);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Rub", item.PriceRub);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Kop", item.PriceKop);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Qty", item.Quantity);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Total", item.TotalPrice);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StatusId", disposedStatusId);

                                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                                }
                            }

                            transaction.Commit();
                             CustomMessageBox.Show("Акт списания создан!");
                            ClearForm();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private int GetDisposedStatusId(SqlConnection conn, SqlTransaction transaction)
        {
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                "SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%'",
                conn, transaction))
            {
                var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                return result != null ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : 1;
            }
        }

        private void ClearForm()
        {
            TbActNumber.Text = GetNextDisposalNumber();
            DpDate.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;
            TbParticipants.Clear();
            CbReason.SelectedIndex = -1;
            _items.Clear();
            _nextRowNum = 1;
            TbTotal.Text = "0.00";
            PnBookDetails.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TbSearchInv.IsEnabled = true;
            DgItems.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TableHeader.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TotalPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        private string GetNextDisposalNumber()
        {
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                    "SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(DisposalNumber, 4, 4) AS INT)), 0) FROM DisposalBooks",
                    conn))
                {
                    int lastNum = Convert.ToInt32(cmd.ExecuteScalar());
                    return $"СП-{(lastNum + 1):D4}";
                }
            }
        }

        private void BtnClose_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.GoBack();
        }
    }
}

            private SolidColorBrush _statusColor;
            public SolidColorBrush StatusColor
            {
                get
                {
                    if (_statusColor == null)
                    {
                        string status = StatusName?.ToLower() ?? "";

                        if (status.Contains("в наличии") || status.Contains("наличие"))
                            _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                        else if (status.Contains("выдана") || status.Contains("выдан"))
                            _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#FFC107"));
                        else if (status.Contains("списана") || status.Contains("списан"))
                            _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545"));
                        else if (status.Contains("реставрация"))
                            _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#17A2B8"));
                        else
                            _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#6C757D"));
                    }
                    return _statusColor;
                }
            }
        }

        private void LoadStatuses()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Status, Title_Status FROM StatusBook ORDER BY Title_Status";

                var statuses = new List<StatusItem>();
                statuses.Add(new StatusItem { ID_Status = 0, Title_Status = "Все статусы" });

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            statuses.Add(new StatusItem
                            {
                                ID_Status = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Status"]),
                                Title_Status = reader["Title_Status"].ToString()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                _allStatuses = statuses;
                FilterStatusCombo.ItemsSource = _allStatuses;
                FilterStatusCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayName";
                FilterStatusCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID_Status";
                FilterStatusCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки статусов: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadBooks()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = @"
                    SELECT 
                        b.IDBook,
                        b.InventaryNumber,
                        b.TitleBook,
                        b.Author,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                        b.YearPublishing,
                        b.PublishingHouse,
                        ISNULL(p.TitlePublishingHouse, '') AS PublishingHouseName,
                        b.Gener,
                        ISNULL(g.TitleGener, '') AS GenreName,
                        b.StatusBook,
                        ISNULL(s.Title_Status, '') AS StatusName
                    FROM Books b
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse p ON b.PublishingHouse = p.IDPublishingHouse
                    LEFT JOIN GenersBook g ON b.Gener = g.ID_Gener
                    LEFT JOIN StatusBook s ON b.StatusBook = s.ID_Status
                    ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                var list = new ObservableCollection<BookItem>();
                var yearsSet = new HashSet<int>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            var book = new BookItem
                            {
                                IDBook = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDBook"]),
                                InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"].ToString(),
                                TitleBook = reader["TitleBook"].ToString(),
                                AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"].ToString(),
                                AuthorID = reader["Author"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Author"]) : (int?)null,
                                YearPublishing = Convert.ToInt32(reader["YearPublishing"]),
                                PublishingHouseName = reader["PublishingHouseName"].ToString(),
                                PublisherID = reader["PublishingHouse"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["PublishingHouse"]) : (int?)null,
                                GenreName = reader["GenreName"].ToString(),
                                GenreID = reader["Gener"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Gener"]) : (int?)null,
                                StatusName = reader["StatusName"].ToString(),
                                StatusID = reader["StatusBook"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["StatusBook"]) : (int?)null
                            };

                            list.Add(book);

                            // Собираем уникальные годы
                            if (book.YearPublishing > 0)
                                yearsSet.Add(book.YearPublishing);
                        }
                    }
                }

                _allBooks = list;
                _filteredBooks = new ObservableCollection<BookItem>(_allBooks);
                DgBooks.ItemsSource = _filteredBooks;

                // Загружаем все фильтры
                LoadStatuses();
                LoadGenres();
                LoadPublishers();
                LoadAuthors();

                // Заполняем фильтр по годам
                LoadYearFilters(yearsSet.ToList());
                UpdateStatistics();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                 CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadYearFilters(List<int> years)
        {
            FilterYearCombo.Items.Clear();
            FilterYearCombo.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = "Все годы", IsSelected = true });

            foreach (var year in years.OrderByDescending(y => y))
            {
                FilterYearCombo.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = year.ToString() });
            }

            FilterYearCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_allBooks == null) return;

            string searchTerm = _isPlaceholderActive ? "" : TbSearch.Text?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "";

            // Получаем выбранные фильтры
            int selectedStatusId = GetSelectedId(FilterStatusCombo);
            int selectedGenreId = GetSelectedId(FilterGenreCombo);
            int selectedPublisherId = GetSelectedId(FilterPublisherCombo);
            int selectedAuthorId = GetSelectedId(FilterAuthorCombo);

            string yearFilter = "Все годы";
            if (FilterYearCombo.SelectedItem is ComboBoxItem yearItem)
            {
                yearFilter = yearItem.Content.ToString();
            }

            var filtered = _allBooks.AsEnumerable();

            // Применяем поиск
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b =>
                    b.InventaryNumber.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.TitleBook.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.AuthorName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.PublishingHouseName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.GenreName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.StatusName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.YearPublishing.ToString().Contains(searchTerm)
                );
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по статусу
            if (selectedStatusId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.StatusID == selectedStatusId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по жанру
            if (selectedGenreId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.GenreID == selectedGenreId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по издательству
            if (selectedPublisherId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.PublisherID == selectedPublisherId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по автору
            if (selectedAuthorId > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.AuthorID == selectedAuthorId);
            }

            // Применяем фильтр по году
            if (yearFilter != "Все годы" && int.TryParse(yearFilter, out int year))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.YearPublishing == year);
            }

            var resultList = filtered.ToList();

            _filteredBooks.Clear();
            foreach (var item in resultList)
            {
                _filteredBooks.Add(item);
            }

            // Обновляем счетчик результатов
            SearchCountLabel.Text = $"Найдено: {resultList.Count} из {_allBooks.Count}";
        }

        private int GetSelectedId(ComboBox comboBox)
        {
            if (comboBox.SelectedValue != null && int.TryParse(comboBox.SelectedValue.ToString(), out int id))
            {
                return id;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allBooks == null) return;

            TotalBooksCount.Text = _allBooks.Count.ToString();

            int availableStatusId = GetStatusIdByPattern("в наличии");
            int issuedStatusId = GetStatusIdByPattern("выдан");
            int disposedStatusId = GetStatusIdByPattern("списан");

            AvailableBooksCount.Text = _allBooks.Count(b => b.StatusID == availableStatusId).ToString();
            IssuedBooksCount.Text = _allBooks.Count(b => b.StatusID == issuedStatusId).ToString();
            DisposedBooksCount.Text = _allBooks.Count(b => b.StatusID == disposedStatusId).ToString();
        }

        private int GetStatusIdByPattern(string pattern)
        {
            var status = _allStatuses.FirstOrDefault(s =>
                s.Title_Status != null && s.Title_Status.ToLower().Contains(pattern.ToLower()));
            return status?.ID_Status ?? 0;
        }

        private void TbSearch_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isPlaceholderActive) return;
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void FilterCombo_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void ClearFiltersBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            TbSearch.Text = "";
            FilterStatusCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterGenreCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterPublisherCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterAuthorCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterYearCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            SetSearchPlaceholder();
        }

       private void DgBooks_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
{
    if (DgBooks.SelectedItem is BookItem selectedBook)
    {
        try
        {
            // Показываем индикатор загрузки
            Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
            
            // Передаем ID книги через конструктор
            var addBookPage = new AddBook(selectedBook.IDBook);
            NavigationService.Navigate(addBookPage);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
             CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при открытии книги: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
        }
    }
}

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadBooks();
        }

        private void BulkAddBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService.Navigate(new BulkAddBooks());
        }

        private void FundMovementBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService.Navigate(new FundMovementPage());
        }
    
    }
}

﻿using Dadata.Model;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class AddReader : Page
    {
        private readonly string connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;MultipleActiveResultSets=True;";
        private ObservableCollection<ReaderItem> _allReaders;
        private int? _currentReaderId;

        public class ReaderTypeItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayTr { get; set; }
            public string TypeName { get; set; }
        }

        public class GroupItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayGr { get; set; }
            public int? SpecialityID { get; set; }
        }

        public class SpecialityItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplaySp { get; set; }
            public string SpecialityCode { get; set; }
            public string NameSpeciality { get; set; }
        }

        public class PostItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayPost { get; set; }
        }

        public class ReaderItem
        {
            public int ReaderID { get; set; }
            public string CardNumber { get; set; }
            public string LastName { get; set; }
            public string FirstName { get; set; }
            public string MiddleName { get; set; }
            public int TypeID { get; set; }
            public string TypeName { get; set; }
            public int? GroupID { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; }
            public int? PostID { get; set; }
            public string PostName { get; set; }
            public string Speciality { get; set; }
            public string PhoneNumber { get; set; }
            public string HomeAddress { get; set; }
            public DateTime MembershipStartDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime FormFillDate { get; set; }

            public string FullName => $"{LastName} {FirstName} {MiddleName}".Trim();
            public string DisplayInfo => $"{CardNumber} - {FullName}";
        }

        private int? _pendingReaderId;
        private bool _isLoadingReader;

        public AddReader(int? readerId = null)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _pendingReaderId = readerId;

            LoadReaderType();
            LoadGroups();
            LoadSpecialities();
            LoadPosts();
            LoadReaders();

            TRCb.SelectionChanged += TRCb_SelectionChanged;
            MembershipStartDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;
            FormFillDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;
            UpdateVisibilityByReaderType();

            TRCb.Loaded += (s, e) => TryLoadPendingReader();
            SpCb.Loaded += (s, e) => TryLoadPendingReader();
            GrCb.Loaded += (s, e) => TryLoadPendingReader();
            PostCb.Loaded += (s, e) => TryLoadPendingReader();

            // Маска ввода ФИО
            LastNameTb.PreviewTextInput += NameField_PreviewTextInput;
            FirstNameTb.PreviewTextInput += NameField_PreviewTextInput;
            MiddleNameTb.PreviewTextInput += NameField_PreviewTextInput;
            LastNameTb.PreviewKeyDown += NameField_PreviewKeyDown;
            FirstNameTb.PreviewKeyDown += NameField_PreviewKeyDown;
            MiddleNameTb.PreviewKeyDown += NameField_PreviewKeyDown;

            // Генерация номера для нового читателя
            if (_pendingReaderId == null)
            {
                Loaded += async (s, e) =>
                {
                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CardNumberTb.Text))
                    {
                        string newNumber = await GetNextCardNumberAsync();
                        CardNumberTb.Text = newNumber;
                    }
                };
            }
        }

        // ==================== МАСКА ВВОДА ДЛЯ ФИО ====================
        private void NameField_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
        {
            e.Handled = !Regex.IsMatch(e.Text, @"^[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ\s\-']$");
        }

        private void NameField_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.V && (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control)
            {
                if (Clipboard.ContainsText())
                {
                    string text = Clipboard.GetText();
                    if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, @"^[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ\s\-']+$"))
                    {
                        e.Handled = true;
                        CustomMessageBox.Show("Поле ФИО может содержать только буквы, пробелы и дефисы.", "Недопустимые символы",
                            CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // ==================== ГЕНЕРАЦИЯ НОМЕРА БИЛЕТА ====================
        private async Task<string> GetNextCardNumberAsync()
        {
            return await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    const string query = "SELECT MAX(CAST(CardNumber AS INT)) FROM ReaderForm WHERE ISNUMERIC(CardNumber) = 1";
                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                        {
                            var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                            int maxNumber = (result != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : 0;
                            int nextNumber = maxNumber + 1;
                            return nextNumber.ToString();
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                    return DateTime.Now.Ticks.ToString().Substring(0, 6);
                }
            });
        }

        // ==================== ПРОВЕРКА АКТИВНЫХ ВЫДАЧ ====================
        private async Task<bool> HasActiveLoansAsync(int readerId)
        {
            return await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    // Индивидуальные выдачи
                    string queryInd = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BookIssuance WHERE ReaderId = @ReaderId AND Status = 'Выдана'";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(queryInd, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                        if ((int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0) return true;
                    }
                    // Групповые выдачи как преподаватель
                    string queryTeach = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GroupBookIssuance WHERE TeacherId = @ReaderId AND Status = 'Выдана'";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(queryTeach, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                        if ((int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0) return true;
                    }
                    // Групповые выдачи как студент
                    string queryStud = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GroupBookIssuance WHERE StudentId = @ReaderId AND Status = 'Выдана'";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(queryStud, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                        if ((int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0) return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }
            });
        }
        private void TryLoadPendingReader()
        {
            if (_pendingReaderId.HasValue && !_isLoadingReader && TRCb.Items.Count > 0 && SpCb.Items.Count > 0)
            {
                _isLoadingReader = true;
                LoadReaderById(_pendingReaderId.Value);
                _pendingReaderId = null;
                _isLoadingReader = false;
            }
        }

        private void ClosePage_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.GoBack();
        }

        private void LoadReaderById(int readerId)
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName,
                        r.TypeID, rt.TypeName,
                        r.GroupID, g.GroupCode,
                        r.Post, p.Post_Name,
                        r.Speciality, r.PhoneNumber, r.HomeAddress,
                        r.MembershipStartDate, r.FormFillDate
                    FROM ReaderForm r
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                    WHERE r.ReaderID = @ReaderId";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                        using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            if (reader.Read())
                            {
                                _currentReaderId = readerId;
                                CardNumberTb.Text = reader["CardNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                LastNameTb.Text = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                FirstNameTb.Text = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                MiddleNameTb.Text = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                NumPhTb.Text = reader["PhoneNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                HomeAdressTb.Text = reader["HomeAddress"]?.ToString() ?? "";

                                if (reader["MembershipStartDate"] != DBNull.Value)
                                    MembershipStartDatePicker.SelectedDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["MembershipStartDate"]);
                                if (reader["FormFillDate"] != DBNull.Value)
                                    FormFillDatePicker.SelectedDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["FormFillDate"]);

                                int typeId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]);
                                SelectComboBoxItemById(TRCb, typeId);
                                string speciality = reader["Speciality"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                SelectSpecialityByDisplay(speciality);
                                UpdateVisibilityByReaderType();

                                if (reader["GroupID"] != DBNull.Value)
                                {
                                    int groupId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]);
                                    SelectComboBoxItemById(GrCb, groupId);
                                }
                                if (reader["Post"] != DBNull.Value)
                                {
                                    int postId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Post"]);
                                    SelectComboBoxItemById(PostCb, postId);
                                }

                                AddReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                                UpdateReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                                DeleteReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                                PrintCardBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки читателя: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void SelectComboBoxItemById(ComboBox comboBox, int id)
        {
            if (comboBox.ItemsSource == null) return;
            foreach (var item in comboBox.Items)
            {
                int itemId = 0;
                if (item is ReaderTypeItem rt) itemId = rt.ID;
                else if (item is GroupItem g) itemId = g.ID;
                else if (item is PostItem p) itemId = p.ID;
                else if (item is ComboBoxItem cbi && cbi.Tag != null) itemId = Convert.ToInt32(cbi.Tag);

                if (itemId == id)
                {
                    comboBox.SelectedItem = item;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        private void SelectSpecialityByDisplay(string displayText)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayText) || SpCb.ItemsSource == null) return;
            foreach (SpecialityItem item in SpCb.Items)
            {
                if (item.DisplaySp == displayText)
                {
                    SpCb.SelectedItem = item;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        private void LoadReaderType()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT TypeID, TypeName, Description FROM ReaderType ORDER BY TypeID";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<ReaderTypeItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new ReaderTypeItem
                            {
                                ID = reader["TypeID"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]),
                                DisplayTr = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                TypeName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }
                        TRCb.ItemsSource = items;
                        TRCb.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayTr";
                        TRCb.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки типа читателя:\n{ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadGroups()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT GroupID, GroupCode, SpecialityID FROM Groups ORDER BY GroupCode";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<GroupItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int? specId = reader["SpecialityID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["SpecialityID"]) : (int?)null;
                            items.Add(new GroupItem
                            {
                                ID = reader["GroupID"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]),
                                DisplayGr = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                SpecialityID = specId
                            });
                        }
                        GrCb.ItemsSource = items;
                        GrCb.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayGr";
                        GrCb.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки групп:\n{ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadSpecialities()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT SpecialityID, SpecialityCode, NameSpeciality FROM Speciality ORDER BY SpecialityCode";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<SpecialityItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new SpecialityItem
                            {
                                ID = reader["SpecialityID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["SpecialityID"]) : 0,
                                DisplaySp = $"{reader["SpecialityCode"]} {reader["NameSpeciality"]}",
                                SpecialityCode = reader["SpecialityCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                NameSpeciality = reader["NameSpeciality"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }
                        SpCb.ItemsSource = items;
                        SpCb.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplaySp";
                        SpCb.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки специальностей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadPosts()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT ID_Post, Post_Name FROM Post ORDER BY Post_Name";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<PostItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["ID_Post"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Post"]) : 0;
                            string name = reader["Post_Name"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            if (id > 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
                                items.Add(new PostItem { ID = id, DisplayPost = name });
                        }
                        PostCb.ItemsSource = items;
                        PostCb.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayPost";
                        PostCb.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки должностей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadReaders()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName,
                        r.TypeID, rt.TypeName,
                        r.GroupID, g.GroupCode,
                        r.Post, p.Post_Name,
                        r.Speciality, r.PhoneNumber, r.HomeAddress,
                        r.MembershipStartDate, r.FormFillDate
                    FROM ReaderForm r
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                    ORDER BY r.LastName, r.FirstName";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<ReaderItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new ReaderItem
                            {
                                ReaderID = reader["ReaderID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReaderID"]) : 0,
                                CardNumber = reader["CardNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                LastName = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                FirstName = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                TypeID = reader["TypeID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]) : 0,
                                TypeName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                GroupID = reader["GroupID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]) : (int?)null,
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PostID = reader["Post"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Post"]) : (int?)null,
                                PostName = reader["Post_Name"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Speciality = reader["Speciality"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PhoneNumber = reader["PhoneNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                HomeAddress = reader["HomeAddress"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MembershipStartDate = reader["MembershipStartDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["MembershipStartDate"]) : DateTime.MinValue,
                                FormFillDate = reader["FormFillDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["FormFillDate"]) : DateTime.MinValue
                            });
                        }
                        _allReaders = items;
                        ReadersListView.ItemsSource = items;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки читателей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void TRCb_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e) => UpdateVisibilityByReaderType();

        private void UpdateVisibilityByReaderType()
        {
            if (TRCb.SelectedItem is ReaderTypeItem selectedType)
            {
                bool isStudent = selectedType.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") ?? false;
                bool isEmployee = selectedType.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") ?? false;
                GrPanel.Visibility = isStudent ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                PostPanel.Visibility = isEmployee ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                if (!isStudent) GrCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
                if (!isEmployee) PostCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
            }
            else
            {
                GrPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                PostPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                GrCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
                PostCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
            }
        }

        private void ClearForm()
        {
            _currentReaderId = null;
            CardNumberTb.Clear();
            LastNameTb.Clear();
            FirstNameTb.Clear();
            MiddleNameTb.Clear();
            TRCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
            SpCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
            GrCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
            PostCb.SelectedIndex = -1;
            NumPhTb.Text = "";
            HomeAdressTb.Clear();
            MembershipStartDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;
            FormFillDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;

            AddReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            UpdateReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            DeleteReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            UpdateVisibilityByReaderType();

            // Асинхронная генерация нового номера
            _ = Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                string newNumber = await GetNextCardNumberAsync();
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => CardNumberTb.Text = newNumber);
            });
        }

        private bool ValidateForm()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CardNumberTb.Text))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите номер читательского билета.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                CardNumberTb.Focus();
                return false;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(LastNameTb.Text))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите фамилию читателя.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                LastNameTb.Focus();
                return false;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FirstNameTb.Text))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите имя читателя.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                FirstNameTb.Focus();
                return false;
            }
            if (TRCb.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите тип читателя.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                TRCb.Focus();
                return false;
            }
            if (!MembershipStartDatePicker.SelectedDate.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Укажите дату начала членства в библиотеке.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                MembershipStartDatePicker.Focus();
                return false;
            }
            if (!FormFillDatePicker.SelectedDate.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Укажите дату оформления читательского билета.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                FormFillDatePicker.Focus();
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        private void AddReaderBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!ValidateForm()) return;
            try
            {
                var selectedType = (ReaderTypeItem)TRCb.SelectedItem;
                bool isStudent = selectedType.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") ?? false;
                bool isEmployee = selectedType.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") ?? false;

                const string query = @"
                    INSERT INTO ReaderForm (
                        CardNumber, LastName, FirstName, MiddleName,
                        TypeID, GroupID, Post, Speciality,
                        PhoneNumber, HomeAddress, MembershipStartDate, FormFillDate
                    ) VALUES (
                        @CardNumber, @LastName, @FirstName, @MiddleName,
                        @TypeID, @GroupID, @Post, @Speciality,
                        @PhoneNumber, @HomeAddress, @MembershipStartDate, @FormFillDate
                    )";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CardNumber", CardNumberTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@LastName", LastNameTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FirstName", FirstNameTb.Text.Trim());
                        // Исправлено: явное приведение к object
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@MiddleName", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(MiddleNameTb.Text) ? (object)DBNull.Value : MiddleNameTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TypeID", selectedType.ID);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", (isStudent && GrCb.SelectedValue != null) ? GrCb.SelectedValue : (object)DBNull.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Post", (isEmployee && PostCb.SelectedValue != null) ? PostCb.SelectedValue : (object)DBNull.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Speciality", (isStudent && SpCb.SelectedValue != null) ? ((SpecialityItem)SpCb.SelectedItem)?.DisplaySp : (object)DBNull.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PhoneNumber", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(NumPhTb.Text) ? (object)DBNull.Value : NumPhTb.Text);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@HomeAddress", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(HomeAdressTb.Text) ? (object)DBNull.Value : HomeAdressTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@MembershipStartDate", MembershipStartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FormFillDate", FormFillDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);

                        int result = command.ExecuteNonQuery();
                        if (result > 0)
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Читатель успешно добавлен.", "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            ClearForm();
                            LoadReaders();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Number == 2627)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Читатель с таким номером билета уже существует.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при добавлении читателя: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateReaderBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentReaderId.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите читателя для редактирования.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }
            if (!ValidateForm()) return;

            try
            {
                var selectedType = (ReaderTypeItem)TRCb.SelectedItem;
                bool isStudent = selectedType.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") ?? false;
                bool isEmployee = selectedType.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") ?? false;

                const string query = @"
                    UPDATE ReaderForm 
                    SET CardNumber = @CardNumber,
                        LastName = @LastName,
                        FirstName = @FirstName,
                        MiddleName = @MiddleName,
                        TypeID = @TypeID,
                        GroupID = @GroupID,
                        Post = @Post,
                        Speciality = @Speciality,
                        PhoneNumber = @PhoneNumber,
                        HomeAddress = @HomeAddress,
                        MembershipStartDate = @MembershipStartDate,
                        FormFillDate = @FormFillDate
                    WHERE ReaderID = @ReaderID";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderID", _currentReaderId.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CardNumber", CardNumberTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@LastName", LastNameTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FirstName", FirstNameTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@MiddleName", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(MiddleNameTb.Text) ? (object)DBNull.Value : MiddleNameTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TypeID", selectedType.ID);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", (isStudent && GrCb.SelectedValue != null) ? GrCb.SelectedValue : (object)DBNull.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Post", (isEmployee && PostCb.SelectedValue != null) ? PostCb.SelectedValue : (object)DBNull.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Speciality", (isStudent && SpCb.SelectedValue != null) ? ((SpecialityItem)SpCb.SelectedItem)?.DisplaySp : (object)DBNull.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PhoneNumber", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(NumPhTb.Text) ? (object)DBNull.Value : NumPhTb.Text);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@HomeAddress", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(HomeAdressTb.Text) ? (object)DBNull.Value : HomeAdressTb.Text.Trim());
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@MembershipStartDate", MembershipStartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FormFillDate", FormFillDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value);

                        int result = command.ExecuteNonQuery();
                        if (result > 0)
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Данные читателя успешно обновлены.", "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            ClearForm();
                            LoadReaders();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Number == 2627)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Читатель с таким номером билета уже существует.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при обновлении читателя: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }
      
        private async Task NullifyGroupLoansReferencesAsync(int readerId)
        {
            await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    // Обнуляем TeacherId
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("UPDATE GroupBookIssuance SET TeacherId = NULL WHERE TeacherId = @ReaderId", conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                    }
                    // Обнуляем StudentId
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("UPDATE GroupBookIssuance SET StudentId = NULL WHERE StudentId = @ReaderId", conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        private async void DeleteReaderBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Обнуляем ссылки в групповых выдачах
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("UPDATE GroupBookIssuance SET TeacherId = NULL WHERE TeacherId = @ReaderId", conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _currentReaderId.Value);
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                }
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("UPDATE GroupBookIssuance SET StudentId = NULL WHERE StudentId = @ReaderId", conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _currentReaderId.Value);
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                }
            }
            if (!_currentReaderId.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите читателя для удаления.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // Проверяем активные выдачи
            bool hasActive = await HasActiveLoansAsync(_currentReaderId.Value);
            if (hasActive)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Невозможно удалить читателя: у него есть невозвращённые книги.\n" +
                    "Сначала примите возврат всех выданных экземпляров.",
                    "Удаление запрещено", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            var result = CustomMessageBox.Show("Вы уверены, что хотите удалить этого читателя?\n" +
                "Все исторические записи о его выдачах сохранятся (без привязки к читателю).",
                "Подтверждение удаления", CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);
            if (result != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                // Удаляем читателя (BookIssuance обнулит ReaderId автоматически)
                const string query = "DELETE FROM ReaderForm WHERE ReaderID = @ReaderID";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderID", _currentReaderId.Value);
                        int rowsAffected = command.ExecuteNonQuery();
                        if (rowsAffected > 0)
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Читатель успешно удалён. Записи о выдачах сохранены.", "Успешно",
                                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            ClearForm();
                            LoadReaders();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Number == 547) // Ошибка внешнего ключа (на случай, если что-то пошло не так)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Невозможно удалить читателя из-за связанных записей. Возможно, есть активные выдачи.",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при удалении: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void ReadersListView_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ReadersListView.SelectedItem is ReaderItem selectedReader)
            {
                _currentReaderId = selectedReader.ReaderID;
                CardNumberTb.Text = selectedReader.CardNumber;
                LastNameTb.Text = selectedReader.LastName;
                FirstNameTb.Text = selectedReader.FirstName;
                MiddleNameTb.Text = selectedReader.MiddleName;
                NumPhTb.Text = selectedReader.PhoneNumber;
                HomeAdressTb.Text = selectedReader.HomeAddress;
                MembershipStartDatePicker.SelectedDate = selectedReader.MembershipStartDate;
                FormFillDatePicker.SelectedDate = selectedReader.FormFillDate;

                foreach (ReaderTypeItem item in TRCb.Items)
                    if (item.ID == selectedReader.TypeID) { TRCb.SelectedItem = item; break; }

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedReader.Speciality))
                {
                    foreach (SpecialityItem item in SpCb.Items)
                        if (item.DisplaySp == selectedReader.Speciality) { SpCb.SelectedItem = item; break; }
                }
                else SpCb.SelectedIndex = -1;

                UpdateVisibilityByReaderType();

                if (selectedReader.GroupID.HasValue) GrCb.SelectedValue = selectedReader.GroupID.Value;
                else GrCb.SelectedIndex = -1;

                if (selectedReader.PostID.HasValue) PostCb.SelectedValue = selectedReader.PostID.Value;
                else PostCb.SelectedIndex = -1;

                AddReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                UpdateReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                DeleteReaderBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                PrintCardBtn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
        }
