﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Windows
{
    public partial class AutorisationWindow : Window
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString =
           "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;";

        public AutorisationWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoginPlaceholder.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(LoginBox.Text)
        ? Visibility.Visible
        : Visibility.Hidden;
            // Подписываемся на событие KeyDown для окна
            this.KeyDown += OnWindowKeyDown;

            // Подписываемся для полей ввода
       
            LoginBox.KeyDown += OnLoginBoxKeyDown;
            PasswordBox.KeyDown += OnPasswordBoxKeyDown;
            VisiblePasswordBox.KeyDown += OnVisiblePasswordBoxKeyDown;
        }

        private void TogglePasswordVisibility_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            VisiblePasswordBox.Text = PasswordBox.Password;
            PasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            VisiblePasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            EyeIcon.Fill = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#007BFF"));

            VisiblePasswordBox.Focus();
            VisiblePasswordBox.CaretIndex = VisiblePasswordBox.Text.Length;
        }

        private void TogglePasswordVisibility_Unchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            PasswordBox.Password = VisiblePasswordBox.Text;
            VisiblePasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            EyeIcon.Fill = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#999999"));

            PasswordBox.Focus();
        }

        private void PasswordBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            PasswordPlaceholder.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
        }

        private void PasswordBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            UpdatePasswordPlaceholder();
        }

        private void PasswordBox_PasswordChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            UpdatePasswordPlaceholder();

            if (VisiblePasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                VisiblePasswordBox.Text = PasswordBox.Password;
            }
        }

        private void UpdatePasswordPlaceholder()
        {
            PasswordPlaceholder.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(PasswordBox.Password)
                ? Visibility.Visible
                : Visibility.Hidden;
        }

        // ==================== ОБРАБОТЧИКИ КЛАВИШИ ENTER ====================

        private void OnWindowKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                PerformLogin();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void OnLoginBoxKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                if (PasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
                {
                    PasswordBox.Focus();
                }
                else
                {
                    VisiblePasswordBox.Focus();
                }
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void OnPasswordBoxKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                PerformLogin();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void OnVisiblePasswordBoxKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                PasswordBox.Password = VisiblePasswordBox.Text;
                PerformLogin();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void PerformLogin()
        {
            string login = LoginBox.Text?.Trim();
            string password = PasswordBox.Password?.Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password) && VisiblePasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                password = VisiblePasswordBox.Text?.Trim();
                PasswordBox.Password = password;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(login) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
            {
                CustomMessageBoxHelper.Show("Введите логин и пароль.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                int userId = -1;
                string fullName = "";
                string storedHash = "";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                        SELECT ID_User, Surname, Name, Patronymic, PasswordHash 
                        FROM Users 
                        WHERE Login = @Login", conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Login", login);

                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            if (reader.Read())
                            {
                                userId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_User"]);
                                fullName = $"{reader["Surname"]} {reader["Name"]}" +
                                          (reader["Patronymic"] != DBNull.Value ? $" {reader["Patronymic"]}" : "");
                                storedHash = reader["PasswordHash"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (userId == -1)
                {
                    CustomMessageBoxHelper.Show("Неверный логин или пароль.", "Ошибка входа",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                    return;
                }

                bool isPasswordValid = VerifyPassword(password, storedHash);

                if (!isPasswordValid)
                {
                    CustomMessageBoxHelper.Show("Неверный логин или пароль.", "Ошибка входа",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                    return;
                }

                var roles = new List<string>();
                using (var conn2 = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn2.Open();
                    using (var cmd2 = new SqlCommand(@"
                        SELECT ur.RoleCode
                        FROM UserRolesAssignments ura
                        JOIN UserRoles ur ON ura.ID_Role = ur.ID_Role
                        WHERE ura.ID_User = @UserId", conn2))
                    {
                        cmd2.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserId", userId);
                        using (var reader2 = cmd2.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader2.Read())
                            {
                                roles.Add(reader2["RoleCode"].ToString());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                var mainWindow = new MainWindow(userId, fullName, roles);
                mainWindow.Show();
                this.Close();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBoxHelper.Show($"Ошибка при входе:\n{ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoginButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            PerformLogin();
        }

        private bool VerifyPassword(string enteredPassword, string storedHash)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(enteredPassword) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedHash))
                return false;

            try
            {
                return BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(enteredPassword, storedHash);
            }
            catch
            {
                return enteredPassword == storedHash;
            }
        }
        private void LoginBox_TextChanged(object sender, System.Windows.Controls.TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoginPlaceholder.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(LoginBox.Text)
                ? Visibility.Visible
                : Visibility.Hidden;
        }
    }
}

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class AuthorService
    {
        private readonly IAuthorRepository _repository;

        public AuthorService(IAuthorRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
        }

        public int AddAuthor(string surname, string name, string patronymic)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(surname))
                throw new ArgumentException("Фамилия не может быть пустой");

            name = name ?? "";
            patronymic = patronymic ?? "";

            if (_repository.AuthorExists(surname.Trim(), name.Trim(), patronymic.Trim()))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Автор уже существует");

            return _repository.InsertAuthor(surname.Trim(), name.Trim(), patronymic.Trim());
        }
    }
}

﻿using System;

    /// Класс для работы с выдачами книг
    /// </summary>
    public class BookIssuanceService
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString;

        // Модели данных
        public class IssuanceItem
        {
            public string IssuanceType { get; set; }
            public int Id { get; set; }
            public DateTime IssuanceDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime PlannedReturnDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime? ReturnDate { get; set; }
            public string Status { get; set; }
            public int RecipientId { get; set; }
            public string RecipientName { get; set; }
            public string RecipientType { get; set; }
            public int BookId { get; set; }
            public string BookTitle { get; set; }
            public string InventaryNumber { get; set; }
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public string Notes { get; set; }
            public List<string> BookList { get; set; }

            // Для отображения в DataGrid
            public string DisplayTime => IssuanceDate.ToString("HH:mm");
            public string DisplayRecipient => $"{RecipientName} ({RecipientType})";

            // Для индивидуальных выдач показываем название книги
            // Для групповых показываем список книг
            public string DisplayBook
            {
                get
                {
                    if (IssuanceType == "individual")
                    {
                        // Для индивидуальных выдач показываем название книги
                        return string.IsNullOrEmpty(BookTitle) ? "Книга не указана" : BookTitle;
                    }
                    else if (IssuanceType == "group")
                    {
                        // Для групповых выдач показываем список книг
                        if (BookList != null && BookList.Any())
                            return string.Join(", ", BookList);
                        else
                            return "Групповая выдача (книги не загружены)";
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        return "Неизвестный тип выдачи";
                    }
                }
            }

            public string IssuanceTypeDisplay { get; set; }
            public SolidColorBrush OverdueColor { get; set; }
            public bool IsOverdue => !ReturnDate.HasValue && DateTime.Now > PlannedReturnDate;
        }

        public class BookInfo

            public int TotalCopies { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получение списка доступных книг (сгруппированных по названию и автору)
        /// </summary>
        public ObservableCollection<BookInfo> GetAvailableBooks(string searchTerm = "")
        {
            var books = new ObservableCollection<BookInfo>();

            string sql = @"
        SELECT 
            b.TitleBook,
            ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
            SUM(b.AvailableCopies) AS TotalAvailableCopies,
            SUM(b.TotalCopies) AS TotalCopies
        FROM Books b
        LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
        WHERE b.AvailableCopies > 0";

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
            {
                sql += " AND (b.TitleBook LIKE @Search OR a.SurnameAuthor LIKE @Search)";
            }

            sql += @" GROUP BY b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor
              ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Search", $"%{searchTerm}%");
                        }

                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                books.Add(new BookInfo
                                {
                                    TitleBook = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    AvailableCopies = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalAvailableCopies"]),
                                    TotalCopies = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalCopies"])
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}");
            }

            return books;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получение списка читателей (студентов)
        /// </summary>
        public ObservableCollection<ReaderInfo> GetReaders(string searchTerm = "")
        {
            var readers = new ObservableCollection<ReaderInfo>();

            string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    r.ReaderID,
                    r.CardNumber,
                    r.LastName,
                    r.FirstName,
                    r.MiddleName,
                    rt.TypeName
                FROM ReaderForm r
                INNER JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                WHERE rt.TypeName LIKE '%студент%' OR rt.TypeName LIKE '%сотрудник%' OR rt.TypeName LIKE '%преподаватель%'";

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
            {
                sql += " AND (r.LastName LIKE @Search OR r.FirstName LIKE @Search OR r.CardNumber LIKE @Search)";
            }

            sql += " ORDER BY r.LastName, r.FirstName";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Search", $"%{searchTerm}%");
                    }

                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            readers.Add(new ReaderInfo
                            {
                                ReaderID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReaderID"]),
                                CardNumber = reader["CardNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                LastName = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                FirstName = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                TypeName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return readers;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получение списка групп
        /// </summary>
        public ObservableCollection<GroupInfo> GetGroups(string searchTerm = "")
        {
            var groups = new ObservableCollection<GroupInfo>();

            string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    g.GroupID,
                    g.GroupCode,
                    s.NameSpeciality AS SpecialityName
                FROM Groups g
                LEFT JOIN Speciality s ON g.SpecialityID = s.SpecialityID";

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
            {
                sql += " WHERE g.GroupCode LIKE @Search";
            }

            sql += " ORDER BY g.GroupCode";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Search", $"%{searchTerm}%");
                    }

                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            groups.Add(new GroupInfo
                            {
                                GroupID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]),
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                SpecialityName = reader["SpecialityName"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return groups;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Создание индивидуальной выдачи
        /// </summary>
        public int CreateIndividualIssuance(int bookId, int readerId, DateTime plannedReturnDate, string notes = "")
        {
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_CreateIndividualIssuance", conn))
                {
                    cmd.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;

                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BookId", bookId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PlannedReturnDate", plannedReturnDate);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Notes", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(notes) ? DBNull.Value : (object)notes);

                    var outputParam = cmd.Parameters.Add("@IssuanceId", SqlDbType.Int);
                    outputParam.Direction = ParameterDirection.Output;

                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();

                    return Convert.ToInt32(outputParam.Value);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Создание групповой выдачи
        /// </summary>
        public int CreateGroupIssuance(
            int groupId,
            int teacherId,
            DateTime plannedReturnDate,
            Dictionary<int, int> booksWithQuantity,
            string subjectName = "",
            string notes = "")
        {
            // Формируем строку для процедуры "BookId1:Quantity1,BookId2:Quantity2"
            var booksList = new StringBuilder();
            foreach (var book in booksWithQuantity)
            {
                if (booksList.Length > 0)
                    booksList.Append(",");
                booksList.Append($"{book.Key}:{book.Value}");
            }

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_CreateGroupIssuance", conn))
                {
                    cmd.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;

                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupId", groupId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TeacherId", teacherId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PlannedReturnDate", plannedReturnDate);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SubjectName", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectName) ? DBNull.Value : (object)subjectName);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Notes", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(notes) ? DBNull.Value : (object)notes);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BooksList", booksList.ToString());

                    var outputParam = cmd.Parameters.Add("@GroupIssuanceId", SqlDbType.Int);
                    outputParam.Direction = ParameterDirection.Output;

                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();

                    return Convert.ToInt32(outputParam.Value);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Возврат книги (индивидуальной или групповой)
        /// </summary>
        public void ReturnBook(string issuanceType, int issuanceId)
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_ReturnBook", conn))
                    {
                        cmd.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;

                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@IssuanceType", issuanceType);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@IssuanceId", issuanceId);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReturnDate", DateTime.Now);

                        System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Вызов sp_ReturnBook: Type={issuanceType}, Id={issuanceId}");

                        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();

                        System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Возврат выполнен успешно");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка в ReturnBook: {ex.Message}");
                throw;
            }
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Получение списка выдач за период
        /// </summary>
        public ObservableCollection<IssuanceItem> GetIssuancesByDate(DateTime date)
        {
            var issuances = new ObservableCollection<IssuanceItem>();

            string sql = @"
        -- Индивидуальные выдачи
        SELECT 
            'individual' AS IssuanceType,
            i.IssuanceId AS Id,
            i.IssuanceDate,
            i.PlannedReturnDate,
            i.ReturnDate,
            i.Status,
            r.ReaderID AS RecipientId,
            CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', r.MiddleName) AS RecipientName,
            'Читатель' AS RecipientType,
            b.IDBook AS BookId,
            b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
            b.InventaryNumber,
            1 AS Quantity,
            i.Notes
        FROM BookIssuance i
        INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
        INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
        WHERE CAST(i.IssuanceDate AS DATE) = @Date

        UNION ALL

        -- Групповые выдачи (сгруппированные)
        SELECT 
            'group' AS IssuanceType,
            gi.GroupIssuanceId AS Id,
            gi.IssuanceDate,
            gi.PlannedReturnDate,
            gi.ReturnDate,
            gi.Status,
            g.GroupID AS RecipientId,
            g.GroupCode + ' - ' + t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName AS RecipientName,
            'Группа' AS RecipientType,
            NULL AS BookId,
            NULL AS BookTitle,  -- Для групповых выдач название будет заполнено позже
            NULL AS InventaryNumber,
            SUM(git.Quantity) AS Quantity,
            gi.Notes
        FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
        INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
        INNER JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
        INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON gi.GroupIssuanceId = git.GroupIssuanceId
        WHERE CAST(gi.IssuanceDate AS DATE) = @Date
        GROUP BY gi.GroupIssuanceId, gi.IssuanceDate, gi.PlannedReturnDate, gi.ReturnDate, 
                 gi.Status, g.GroupID, g.GroupCode, t.LastName, t.FirstName, gi.Notes

        ORDER BY IssuanceDate DESC";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", date.Date);

                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            var issuance = new IssuanceItem
                            {
                                IssuanceType = reader["IssuanceType"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Id"]),
                                IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                ReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null,
                                Status = reader["Status"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                RecipientId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["RecipientId"]),
                                RecipientName = reader["RecipientName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                RecipientType = reader["RecipientType"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                BookId = reader["BookId"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["BookId"]) : 0,
                                BookTitle = reader["BookTitle"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                Notes = reader["Notes"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                BookList = new List<string>()
                            };

                            issuances.Add(issuance);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Для групповых выдач загружаем список книг отдельно
            foreach (var issuance in issuances.Where(i => i.IssuanceType == "group"))
            {
                issuance.BookList = GetGroupBookTitles(issuance.Id);
                // Для отладки
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Групповая выдача {issuance.Id}: загружено {issuance.BookList.Count} книг");
            }

            // Для отладки индивидуальных выдач
            foreach (var issuance in issuances.Where(i => i.IssuanceType == "individual"))
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Индивидуальная выдача {issuance.Id}: книга '{issuance.BookTitle}'");
            }

            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Загружено выдач: {issuances.Count} (инд: {issuances.Count(i => i.IssuanceType == "individual")}, групп: {issuances.Count(i => i.IssuanceType == "group")})");

            return issuances;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// <summary>
        /// Получает список книг для групповой выдачи (с группировкой по названию)
        /// </summary>
        private List<string> GetGroupBookTitles(int groupIssuanceId)
        {
            var books = new List<string>();

            try
            {
                string sql = @"
            SELECT 
                b.TitleBook,
                SUM(git.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity
            FROM GroupIssuanceItems git
            INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
            WHERE git.GroupIssuanceId = @GroupIssuanceId
            GROUP BY b.TitleBook
            ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupIssuanceId", groupIssuanceId);

                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                string title = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                int quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalQuantity"]);

                                books.Add($"{title} ({quantity} шт.)");

                                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Книга: {title}, количество: {quantity}");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Загружено книг для групповой выдачи {groupIssuanceId}: {books.Count}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки книг для групповой выдачи {groupIssuanceId}: {ex.Message}");
            }

            return books;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Получение активных выдач читателя
        /// </summary>
        public ObservableCollection<IssuanceItem> GetReaderActiveIssuances(int readerId)
        {
            var issuances = new ObservableCollection<IssuanceItem>();

            string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    'individual' AS IssuanceType,
                    i.IssuanceId AS Id,
                    i.IssuanceDate,
                    i.PlannedReturnDate,
                    i.ReturnDate,
                    i.Status,
                    i.ReaderId AS RecipientId,
                    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', r.MiddleName) AS RecipientName,
                    'Читатель' AS RecipientType,
                    b.IDBook AS BookId,
                    b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
                    b.InventaryNumber,
                    1 AS Quantity,
                    i.Notes
                FROM BookIssuance i
                INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
                INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
                WHERE i.ReaderId = @ReaderId AND i.ReturnDate IS NULL
                ORDER BY i.PlannedReturnDate";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);

                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            issuances.Add(new IssuanceItem
                            {
                                IssuanceType = reader["IssuanceType"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Id"]),
                                IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                ReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null,
                                Status = reader["Status"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                RecipientId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["RecipientId"]),
                                RecipientName = reader["RecipientName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                RecipientType = reader["RecipientType"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                BookId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["BookId"]),
                                BookTitle = reader["BookTitle"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                Notes = reader["Notes"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return issuances;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Создание групповой выдачи с несколькими книгами
        /// </summary>
        public int CreateGroupIssuanceWithBooks(
     int groupId,
     int teacherId,
     int studentId,
     DateTime plannedReturnDate,
     List<int> bookIds,
     string subjectName = "",
     string notes = "")
        {
            if (bookIds == null || bookIds.Count == 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Список книг не может быть пустым");

            // Формируем строку с ID книг через запятую
            string bookIdsString = string.Join(",", bookIds);

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_CreateGroupIssuanceWithBooks", conn))
                {
                    cmd.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;

                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupId", groupId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TeacherId", teacherId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StudentId", studentId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PlannedReturnDate", plannedReturnDate);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SubjectName", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectName) ? DBNull.Value : (object)subjectName);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Notes", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(notes) ? DBNull.Value : (object)notes);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BookIds", bookIdsString);

                    var outputParam = cmd.Parameters.Add("@GroupIssuanceId", SqlDbType.Int);
                    outputParam.Direction = ParameterDirection.Output;

                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();

                    return Convert.ToInt32(outputParam.Value);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class BookService
    {
        private readonly IBookRepository _repository;

        public BookService(IBookRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
        }

        public int AddBook(string invNumber, string title, int authorId, int? publisherId,
                          int year, int? genreId, int? statusId, string annotation,
                          int? receiptId, int viewId, string price)
        {
            // Валидация обязательных полей
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(invNumber))
                throw new ArgumentException("Инвентарный номер не может быть пустым");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
                throw new ArgumentException("Название не может быть пустым");

            if (authorId <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Не выбран автор");

            if (viewId <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Не выбран вид книги");

            // Проверка года
            if (year < 1000 || year > DateTime.Now.Year)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Год должен быть от 1000 до {DateTime.Now.Year}");

            // Проверка уникальности инвентарного номера
            if (_repository.BookExists(invNumber.Trim()))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Инвентарный номер уже существует");

            // Сохранение книги
            return _repository.InsertBook(
                invNumber.Trim(),
                title.Trim(),
                authorId,
                publisherId,
                year,
                genreId,
                statusId,
                annotation?.Trim(),
                receiptId,
                viewId,
                price?.Trim());
        }
    }
}

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class GenreService
    {
        private readonly IGenreRepository _repository;

        public GenreService(IGenreRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
        }

        public int AddGenre(string title)
        {
            // Валидация
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
                throw new ArgumentException("Название жанра не может быть пустым");

            // Очищаем от пробелов
            string trimmedTitle = title.Trim();

            // Проверка на дубликат
            if (_repository.GenreExists(trimmedTitle))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Жанр '{trimmedTitle}' уже существует");

            // Сохраняем
            return _repository.InsertGenre(trimmedTitle);
        }

        public IEnumerable<dynamic> SearchGenres(string searchTerm)
        {
            var allGenres = _repository.GetAllGenres();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
                return allGenres;

            // Поиск без учета регистра
            return allGenres.Where(g =>
                g.TitleGener.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0);
        }

        public void UpdateGenre(int id, string title)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
                throw new ArgumentException("Название жанра не может быть пустым");

            string trimmedTitle = title.Trim();

            var existing = _repository.GetGenreById(id);
            if (existing == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Жанр не найден");

            // Если название изменилось, проверяем уникальность
            if (!existing.TitleGener.Equals(trimmedTitle, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                if (_repository.GenreExists(trimmedTitle))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Жанр '{trimmedTitle}' уже существует");
            }

            _repository.UpdateGenre(id, trimmedTitle);
        }

        public void DeleteGenre(int id)
        {
            var existing = _repository.GetGenreById(id);
            if (existing == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Жанр не найден");

            _repository.DeleteGenre(id);
        }
    }
}

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class ReceiptService
    {
        private readonly IReceiptRepository _repository;
        private readonly ReceiptNumberGenerator _generator;

        public ReceiptService(IReceiptRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
            _generator = new ReceiptNumberGenerator();
        }

        // Для тестирования с возможностью подмены генератора
        public ReceiptService(IReceiptRepository repository, ReceiptNumberGenerator generator)
        {
            _repository = repository;
            _generator = generator;
        }

        public int AddReceipt(int responsibleId, string comment)
        {
            // Валидация
            if (responsibleId <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Неверный ID ответственного лица");

            // Получаем следующий номер
            int nextId = _repository.GetNextReceiptNumber();
            string number = _generator.GenerateReceiptNumber(nextId);

            // Сохраняем накладную
            return _repository.InsertReceipt(
                number,
                DateTime.Now,
                responsibleId,
                comment ?? ""); // null comment -> пустая строка
        }
    }
}

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class UserService
    {
        private readonly IUserRepository _repository;

        public UserService(IUserRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
        }

        public int AddUser(string surname, string name, string patronymic,
                          string login, string password, List<int> roleIds)
        {
            // Валидация
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(surname))
                throw new ArgumentException("Фамилия не может быть пустой");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
                throw new ArgumentException("Имя не может быть пустым");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(login))
                throw new ArgumentException("Логин не может быть пустым");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
                throw new ArgumentException("Пароль не может быть пустым");

            if (roleIds == null || roleIds.Count == 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Должна быть выбрана хотя бы одна роль");

            // Проверка уникальности логина - ВАЖНО!
            if (_repository.LoginExists(login.Trim()))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Логин уже занят");

            // Создание пользователя
            int userId = _repository.InsertUser(
                surname.Trim(),
                name.Trim(),
                patronymic?.Trim() ?? "",
                login.Trim(),
                password);

            // Назначение ролей - ВАЖНО!
            if (userId > 0 && roleIds.Count > 0)
            {
                _repository.AssignRolesToUser(userId, roleIds);
            }

            return userId;
        }
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class AddressSuggestionService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private const string API_KEY = "fa8268132e66435ee0b5961551ed008c55eb8b9b"; // Получите на dadata.ru
        private const string SECRET_KEY = "e8b4218db8cb51cb5ffceb608c48da1d5da4ffe6";

        public AddressSuggestionService()
        {
            _httpClient = new HttpClient();
            _httpClient.BaseAddress = new Uri("https://suggestions.dadata.ru/suggestions/api/4_1/rs/");
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =
                new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Token", API_KEY);
            _httpClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(
                new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
        }

        public async Task<List<string>> SuggestAddress(string query)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || query.Length < 3)
                return new List<string>();

            var request = new
            {
                query = query,
                count = 10,
                language = "ru"
            };

            var content = new StringContent(
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(request),
                Encoding.UTF8,
                "application/json");

            var response = await _httpClient.PostAsync("suggest/address", content);

            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                var result = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AddressSuggestionResponse>(json);
                return result?.Suggestions?.Select(s => s.Value).ToList() ?? new List<string>();
            }

            return new List<string>();
        }
    }

    public class AddressSuggestionResponse
    {
        public List<AddressSuggestion> Suggestions { get; set; }
    }

    public class AddressSuggestion
    {
        public string Value { get; set; }
        public string UnrestrictedValue { get; set; }
        public object Data { get; set; }
    }
}

using System.Windows;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Controls
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Класс-помощник для замены стандартного MessageBox на кастомный
    /// Используется для быстрой замены  CustomMessageBox.Show() на CustomMessageBoxHelper.Show()
    /// </summary>
    public static class CustomMessageBoxHelper
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает сообщение с одной кнопкой OK
        /// </summary>
        public static MessageBoxResult Show(string message)
        {
            var result =  CustomMessageBox.Show(message);
            return ConvertResult(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает сообщение с заголовком
        /// </summary>
        public static MessageBoxResult Show(string message, string caption)
        {
            var result =  CustomMessageBox.Show(message, caption);
            return ConvertResult(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает сообщение с заголовком и кнопками
        /// </summary>
        public static MessageBoxResult Show(string message, string caption, CustomMessageBoxButton button)
        {
            var customButton = ConvertButton(button);
            var result =  CustomMessageBox.Show(message, caption, customButton);
            return ConvertResult(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает сообщение с заголовком, кнопками и иконкой
        /// </summary>
        public static MessageBoxResult Show(string message, string caption, CustomMessageBoxButton button, CustomMessageBoxImage icon)
        {
            var customButton = ConvertButton(button);
            var customIcon = ConvertIcon(icon);
            var result =  CustomMessageBox.Show(message, caption, customButton, customIcon);
            return ConvertResult(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает сообщение с владельцем
        /// </summary>
        public static MessageBoxResult Show(Window owner, string message, string caption, CustomMessageBoxButton button, CustomMessageBoxImage icon)
        {
            var customButton = ConvertButton(button);
            var customIcon = ConvertIcon(icon);
            var result =  CustomMessageBox.Show(owner, message, caption, customButton, customIcon);
            return ConvertResult(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Конвертирует стандартную CustomMessageBoxButton в CustomMessageBoxButton
        /// </summary>
        private static CustomMessageBoxButton ConvertButton(CustomMessageBoxButton button)
        {
            switch (button)
            {
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.OK:
                    return CustomMessageBoxButton.OK;
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.OKCancel:
                    return CustomMessageBoxButton.OKCancel;
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo:
                    return CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo;
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel:
                    return CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel;
                default:
                    return CustomMessageBoxButton.OK;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Конвертирует стандартную CustomMessageBoxImage в CustomMessageBoxImage
        /// </summary>
        private static CustomMessageBoxImage ConvertIcon(CustomMessageBoxImage icon)
        {
            switch (icon)
            {
                case CustomMessageBoxImage.Information:
                    return CustomMessageBoxImage.Information;
                case CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning:
                    return CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning;
                case CustomMessageBoxImage.Error:
                    return CustomMessageBoxImage.Error;
                case CustomMessageBoxImage.Question:
                    return CustomMessageBoxImage.Question;
                case CustomMessageBoxImage.None:
                default:
                    return CustomMessageBoxImage.None;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Конвертирует CustomMessageBoxResult в стандартный MessageBoxResult
        /// </summary>
        private static MessageBoxResult ConvertResult(CustomMessageBoxResult result)
        {
            switch (result)
            {
                case CustomMessageBoxResult.OK:
                    return MessageBoxResult.OK;
                case CustomMessageBoxResult.Cancel:
                    return MessageBoxResult.Cancel;
                case CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes:
                    return MessageBoxResult.Yes;
                case CustomMessageBoxResult.No:
                    return MessageBoxResult.No;
                case CustomMessageBoxResult.Abort:
                    return MessageBoxResult.No;
                case CustomMessageBoxResult.Retry:
                    return MessageBoxResult.Yes;
                case CustomMessageBoxResult.Ignore:
                    return MessageBoxResult.None;
                default:
                    return MessageBoxResult.None;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Controls
{
    // Убедитесь, что используются эти enum, а не системные
    public enum CustomMessageBoxButton
    {
        OK,
        OKCancel,
        YesNo,
        YesNoCancel,
        AbortRetryIgnore
    }

    public enum CustomMessageBoxImage
    {
        None,
        Information,
        Warning,
        Error,
        Question
    }

    public enum CustomMessageBoxResult
    {
        None = 0,
        OK = 1,
        Cancel = 2,
        Yes = 6,
        No = 7,
        Abort = 3,
        Retry = 4,
        Ignore = 5
    }

    public partial class CustomMessageBox : Window
    {
        private CustomMessageBoxResult _result = CustomMessageBoxResult.None;

        // Объявляем без "?", так как C# 7.3
        private Image _messageIcon;
        private TextBlock _messageText;
        private StackPanel _buttonsPanel;

        // Временное хранение данных до загрузки шаблона
        private string _pendingMessage;
        private CustomMessageBoxImage _pendingIcon;
        private CustomMessageBoxButton _pendingButtons;

        public CustomMessageBox()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            this.Loaded += CustomMessageBox_Loaded;
        }

        private void CustomMessageBox_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Получаем элементы из шаблона
            _messageIcon = GetTemplateChild("MessageIcon") as Image;
            _messageText = GetTemplateChild("MessageText") as TextBlock;
            _buttonsPanel = GetTemplateChild("ButtonsPanel") as StackPanel;

            // Если данные были переданы до загрузки, применяем их сейчас
            if (_messageText != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_pendingMessage))
            {
                _messageText.Text = _pendingMessage;
            }

            ApplyIcon(_pendingIcon);
            CreateButtons(_pendingButtons);
        }

        public static CustomMessageBoxResult Show(string message)
        {
            return ShowInternal(message, string.Empty, CustomMessageBoxButton.OK,CustomMessageBoxImage.None, null);
        }

        public static CustomMessageBoxResult Show(string message, string caption)
        {
            return ShowInternal(message, caption, CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.None, null);
        }

        public static CustomMessageBoxResult Show(string message, string caption, CustomMessageBoxButton button)
        {
            return ShowInternal(message, caption, button, CustomMessageBoxImage.None, null);
        }

        public static CustomMessageBoxResult Show(string message, string caption, CustomMessageBoxButton button, CustomMessageBoxImage icon)
        {
            return ShowInternal(message, caption, button, icon, null);
        }

        public static CustomMessageBoxResult Show(Window owner, string message, string caption, CustomMessageBoxButton button, CustomMessageBoxImage icon)
        {
            return ShowInternal(message, caption, button, icon, owner);
        }

        private static CustomMessageBoxResult ShowInternal(string message, string caption, CustomMessageBoxButton button, CustomMessageBoxImage icon, Window owner)
        {
            var messageBox = new CustomMessageBox
            {
                Title = string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption) ? "Сообщение" : caption,
                _pendingMessage = message,
                _pendingIcon = icon,
                _pendingButtons = button
            };

            if (owner != null)
            {
                messageBox.Owner = owner;
                messageBox.WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
            }
            else
            {
                messageBox.WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen;
            }

             messageBox.ShowDialog();
            return messageBox._result;
        }

        private void ApplyIcon(CustomMessageBoxImage icon)
        {
            if (_messageIcon == null) return;

            _messageIcon.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

            if (icon == CustomMessageBoxImage.None)
                return;

            var drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
            using (var context = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
            {
                var fillColor = Colors.Gray;
                var symbol = "";

                switch (icon)
                {
                    case CustomMessageBoxImage.Information:
                        fillColor = Color.FromRgb(0, 123, 255);
                        symbol = "ℹ";
                        break;
                    case CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning:
                        fillColor = Color.FromRgb(255, 193, 7);
                        symbol = "⚠";
                        break;
                    case CustomMessageBoxImage.Error:
                        fillColor = Color.FromRgb(220, 53, 69);
                        symbol = "✕";
                        break;
                    case CustomMessageBoxImage.Question:
                        fillColor = Color.FromRgb(0, 123, 255);
                        symbol = "?";
                        break;
                }

                context.DrawEllipse(new SolidColorBrush(fillColor), null, new Point(24, 24), 20, 20);

                var formattedText = new FormattedText(
                    symbol,
                    CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
                    FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                    new Typeface("Segoe UI"),
                    28,
                    Brushes.White,
                    VisualTreeHelper.GetDpi(this).PixelsPerDip);

                context.DrawText(formattedText, new Point(24 - formattedText.Width / 2, 24 - formattedText.Height / 2));
            }

            var renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(48, 48, 96, 96, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
            renderTargetBitmap.Render(drawingVisual);

            _messageIcon.Source = renderTargetBitmap;
            _messageIcon.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }

        private void CreateButtons(CustomMessageBoxButton buttonType)
        {
            if (_buttonsPanel == null) return;

            _buttonsPanel.Children.Clear();

            switch (buttonType)
            {
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.OK:
                    CreateButton("OK", CustomMessageBoxResult.OK, true);
                    break;
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.OKCancel:
                    CreateButton("OK", CustomMessageBoxResult.OK, true);
                    CreateButton("Отмена", CustomMessageBoxResult.Cancel, false);
                    break;
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo:
                    CreateButton("Да", CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes, true);
                    CreateButton("Нет", CustomMessageBoxResult.No, false);
                    break;
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel:
                    CreateButton("Да", CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes, true);
                    CreateButton("Нет", CustomMessageBoxResult.No, false);
                    CreateButton("Отмена", CustomMessageBoxResult.Cancel, false);
                    break;
                case CustomMessageBoxButton.AbortRetryIgnore:
                    CreateButton("Прервать", CustomMessageBoxResult.Abort, true);
                    CreateButton("Повторить", CustomMessageBoxResult.Retry, false);
                    CreateButton("Игнорировать", CustomMessageBoxResult.Ignore, false);
                    break;
            }
        }

        private void CreateButton(string text, CustomMessageBoxResult result, bool isDefault)
        {
            if (_buttonsPanel == null) return;

            var button = new Button
            {
                Content = text,
                MinWidth = 80,
                Height = 36,
                Margin = new Thickness(5, 0, 0, 0),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
                Tag = result,
                IsDefault = isDefault
            };

            // Пытаемся найти стиль, если не найден - кнопка будет стандартной, но рабочей
            if (Application.Current.TryFindResource("SaveButtonStyle") is Style btnStyle)
            {
                button.Style = btnStyle;
            }
            // Если стиля нет, можно задать базовые свойства здесь, чтобы кнопка точно была видна
            else
            {
                button.Background = Brushes.LightGray;
                button.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                button.BorderBrush = Brushes.Gray;
                button.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1);
            }

            if (isDefault)
            {
                button.Focus();
            }

            button.Click += (sender, e) =>
            {
                _result = result;
                Close();
            };

            _buttonsPanel.Children.Add(button);
        }

        private void CloseButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _result = CustomMessageBoxResult.Cancel;
            Close();
        }

        protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnKeyDown(e);

            if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
            {
                _result = CustomMessageBoxResult.Cancel;
                Close();
            }

            if (e.Key == Key.Enter && _buttonsPanel != null)
            {
                foreach (var child in _buttonsPanel.Children)
                {
                    if (child is Button btn && btn.IsDefault)
                    {
                        btn.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(Button.ClickEvent));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

﻿<UserControl x:Class="Diplom_Bibl.Controls.AddressSearchTextBox"

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Configuration;
using System.Net.NetworkInformation;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using Dadata;
using Dadata.Model;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls; // для CustomMessageBox

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Controls
{
    public partial class AddressSearchTextBox : UserControl
    {
        // Читаем ключи из конфигурации
        private readonly string API_TOKEN = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["DaDataApiKey"];
        private readonly string SECRET_KEY = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["DaDataSecretKey"];

        private SuggestClientAsync _suggestClient;
        private CleanClientAsync _cleanClient;
        private DispatcherTimer _searchTimer;
        private bool _isInternetWarningShown = false; // флаг, чтобы не спамить сообщением

        public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedAddressProperty =
            DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedAddress", typeof(string), typeof(AddressSearchTextBox),
                new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault));

        public string SelectedAddress
        {
            get { return (string)GetValue(SelectedAddressProperty); }
            set { SetValue(SelectedAddressProperty, value); }
        }

        public string Text
        {
            get { return AddressTextBox.Text; }
            set { AddressTextBox.Text = value; }
        }

        public AddressSearchTextBox()
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            // Проверяем наличие ключей
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(API_TOKEN) || API_TOKEN == "fa8268132e66435ee0b5961551ed008c55eb8b9b")
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("ВНИМАНИЕ: Не настроены API ключи DaData!");
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("Получите ключи на https://dadata.ru и добавьте в App.config");
            }

            InitializeDaDataClient();
            InitializeSearchTimer();
        }

        private void InitializeDaDataClient()
        {
            try
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(API_TOKEN))
                {
                    _suggestClient = new SuggestClientAsync(API_TOKEN);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SECRET_KEY))
                    {
                        _cleanClient = new CleanClientAsync(API_TOKEN, SECRET_KEY);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка инициализации DaData: {ex.Message}");
                ShowNoInternetMessage();
            }
        }

        private void InitializeSearchTimer()
        {
            _searchTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
            _searchTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300);
            _searchTimer.Tick += async (s, e) =>
            {
                _searchTimer.Stop();
                await SearchAddresses(AddressTextBox.Text);
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверяет наличие интернет-соединения
        /// </summary>
        private bool IsInternetAvailable()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var ping = new Ping())
                {
                    // Пинг до DNS Google (быстрый и надёжный)
                    var reply = ping.Send("8.8.8.8", 2000);
                    return reply != null && reply.Status == IPStatus.Success;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает предупреждение об отсутствии интернета (не чаще одного раза за сеанс)
        /// </summary>
        private void ShowNoInternetMessage()
        {
            if (!_isInternetWarningShown)
            {
                _isInternetWarningShown = true;
                // Используем тот же стиль сообщений, что и во всём проекте
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Отсутствует подключение к интернету. Поиск адресов недоступен.",
                    "Нет соединения", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
            }
        }

        private async Task SearchAddresses(string query)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || query.Length < 3)
            {
                SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
                return;
            }

            // Проверяем интернет-соединение
            if (!IsInternetAvailable())
            {
                ShowNoInternetMessage();
                SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                if (_suggestClient == null)
                {
                    // Если API не настроен, показываем тестовые данные
                    ShowTestData(query);
                    return;
                }

                var request = new SuggestAddressRequest(query)
                {
                    count = 10,
                    language = "ru",
                };

                var response = await _suggestClient.SuggestAddress(request);

                if (response?.suggestions != null && response.suggestions.Count > 0)
                {
                    var suggestions = new List<string>();
                    foreach (var suggestion in response.suggestions)
                    {
                        suggestions.Add(suggestion.value);
                    }

                    SuggestionsListBox.ItemsSource = suggestions;
                    SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка поиска адреса: {ex.Message}");
                // Если ошибка сетевого характера, показываем предупреждение
                if (ex is System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException ||
                    ex.Message.Contains("network") ||
                    ex.Message.Contains("internet"))
                {
                    ShowNoInternetMessage();
                }
                // В любом случае показываем тестовые данные для демонстрации
                ShowTestData(query);
            }
        }

        // Тестовые данные на случай отсутствия API или интернета
        private void ShowTestData(string query)
        {
            var testSuggestions = new List<string>
            {
               {query}
               
            };

            SuggestionsListBox.ItemsSource = testSuggestions;
            SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = true;
        }

        private async void SuggestionsListBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SuggestionsListBox.SelectedItem != null)
            {
                string selectedAddress = SuggestionsListBox.SelectedItem.ToString();

                // Если есть клиент для стандартизации, можно улучшить адрес
                if (_cleanClient != null && IsInternetAvailable())
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var cleanedAddress = await _cleanClient.Clean<Address>(selectedAddress);
                        selectedAddress = cleanedAddress.result ?? selectedAddress;
                    }
                    catch { /* Игнорируем ошибки стандартизации */ }
                }

                AddressTextBox.Text = selectedAddress;
                SelectedAddress = selectedAddress;
                SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
            }
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            AddressTextBox.Clear();
            SelectedAddress = null;
            SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
        }

        private void AddressTextBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
            {
                if (!SuggestionsListBox.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
                {
                    SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
                }
            }), DispatcherPriority.Background);
        }

        private void AddressTextBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (AddressTextBox.Text.Length >= 3)
            {
                AddressTextBox_TextChanged(sender, null);
            }
        }

        private void AddressTextBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Перезапускаем таймер при каждом изменении текста
            _searchTimer.Stop();
            _searchTimer.Start();
        }

        private void AddressTextBox_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen)
            {
                switch (e.Key)
                {
                    case Key.Down:
                        if (SuggestionsListBox.SelectedIndex < SuggestionsListBox.Items.Count - 1)
                            SuggestionsListBox.SelectedIndex++;
                        e.Handled = true;
                        break;
                    case Key.Up:
                        if (SuggestionsListBox.SelectedIndex > 0)
                            SuggestionsListBox.SelectedIndex--;
                        e.Handled = true;
                        break;
                    case Key.Enter:
                        if (SuggestionsListBox.SelectedItem != null)
                        {
                            AddressTextBox.Text = SuggestionsListBox.SelectedItem.ToString();
                            SelectedAddress = AddressTextBox.Text;
                            SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
                        }
                        e.Handled = true;
                        break;
                    case Key.Escape:
                        SuggestionsPopup.IsOpen = false;
                        e.Handled = true;
                        break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Converters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Конвертер для преобразования null или пустой строки в Visibility
    /// </summary>
    public class IsNullOrEmptyToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            string text = value as string;

            if (parameter != null && parameter.ToString() == "inverse")
            {
                // Обратный режим: пусто = Visible, не пусто = Collapsed
                return string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            }

            // Прямой режим: не пусто = Visible, пусто = Collapsed
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}
